Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JxuXTJIKRwmYn08D]{Drain Realm}

Your Strikes deal an additional 1d8 damage of your realm's damage type.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HlqAdfxmcd9gdgHa]{Draw From the Land}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.R7c4PyTNkZb0yvoT]{Стійка грізного маршала}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до кидків шкоди. Коли маршал або союзник в аурі критично влучає у ворога Ударом, цей ворог стає @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Зляканим 1}. Якщо маршал володіє зброєю, що має більше ніж одну кістку шкоди (зазвичай завдяки ударній руні), статусний бонус може дорівнювати кількості кісток шкоди зброї замість +1.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.R7c4PyTNkZb0yvoT]{Dread Marshal Stance}

You gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls. When the marshal or an ally in the aura critically hit an enemy with a Strike, that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. If the marshal is wielding a weapon that has more than one damage die (typically due to a striking rune), you can have the status bonus equal the weapon's number of damage dice instead of +1.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.D91jQs0wleU5ml4K]{Drink from the Chalice}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the origin's level (minimum 3). If the origin is under the effects of the chalice's adept benefit, these temporary Hit Points increase to twice their level.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.n7nQQR940OvFbw7T]{Дуельне парирування}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до КЗ.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.n7nQQR940OvFbw7T]{Dueling Parry}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5op3m0gwZjL4udit]{Duelist's Challenge}

Any time you hit your dueling opponent using a single one-handed melee weapon while your other hand or hands are free, you gain a circumstance bonus to the Strike's damage equal to the number of damage dice your weapon deals.

If you attack a creature other than your dueling opponent, you take a circumstance penalty to damage equal to the number of damage dice your weapon deals.
You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.nKkbEKbE9vfKWKdd]{Echoes in Stone}

You gain imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t7SlYWC4M2JcgwRM]{Echolocation}

You can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet.

Grabted by Edict of Mortality

if you attempt to Cast a Spell with the divine trait, you must succeed at a flat check or the action is lost.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9cHQua33V35JPE3U]{Educate Allies}.

All allies affected by your composition spell gain your +1 circumstance bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iX5HEqRImhKzfPR2]{Well-Versed} until the start of your next turn. Your personal circumstance bonus from Well-Versed also increases to +2 until the start of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zfnZki2CxmZXdNBO]{Electric Counter}

You gain resistance to electricity equal to your level.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OKSsFlHY5UKc4dKu]{Стихійний напад}

Ваші Удари завдають додатково 1d6 шкоди зазначеного типу та мають трейт, що відповідає стихії: електрика для повітря, дробляча для землі, вогонь для вогню або холод для води.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OKSsFlHY5UKc4dKu]{Elemental Assault}

Your Strikes deal an additional 1d6 damage of the indicated type and have the trait corresponding to the element: electricity for air, bludgeoning for earth, fire for fire, or cold for water.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RXRnJcG4XSabZ35a]{Родовід: Стихійний}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до перевірок Залякування.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RXRnJcG4XSabZ35a]{Bloodline: Elemental}

You gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IUVzB39pRVyBFOEx]{Elemental Bulwark}

You gain resistance against the triggering damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tx9pkrpmtqe4FnvS]{Посвята стихійника}

Щодня під час щоденних приготувань ви можете налаштуватися на одну стихію на свій вибір зі своєї стихійної філософії. Ви отримуєте опір, що дорівнює половині вашого рівня (мінімум 1), до шкоди від ефектів із трейтом налаштованої стихії. Це налаштування триває до наступних щоденних приготувань.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tx9pkrpmtqe4FnvS]{Elementalist Dedication}

Each day when you make your daily preparations, you can attune yourself to one element of your choice from your elemental philosophy. You gain resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1 resistance) against damage dealt by effects with your attuned elemental trait. This attunement lasts until you next make your daily preparations.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xAFdoKl7aOP9rVkl]{Emblazon Antimagic}

  • Shield You gain the shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against magic.
  • Weapon When you critically hit with the weapon, you can attempt to counteract a spell on the target, using half your level, rounded up, as the counteract rank.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7RFjTTzznsdPcaYB]{Emblazon Armament}

  • Shield The shield gains a +1 status bonus to its Hardness.
  • Weapon The wielder gains a +1 status bonus to damage rolls with the weapon.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rKZE8BA9IQHSSWoW]{Emblazon Energy}

  • Shield Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against that damage type.
  • Weapon Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The weapon deals an extra 1d4 damage of that type. Increase this extra damage to 1d6 if you have a domain spell with a trait matching that type.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uYhaIKxlvGj4YNCc]{Emboldened with Glorious Purpose}

You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 against emotion and fear effects.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9AZjpeeS824VsYv8]{Emergency Medical Assistance}

Your DC is reduced from 15 to 10 for all future flat checks to remove the persistent damage.

description.translate: Ви активуєте свій емоційний запал.
description.original: You activate your emotional fervor.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.d8DI7wLxtUy99g9K]{Емоційний сплеск}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до кидків атаки та перевірок навичок.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.d8DI7wLxtUy99g9K]{Emotional Surge}

You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MS53Ds75BT379ZFm]{Empathetic Plea}

You take a -2 circumstance penalty to damage on the triggering Strike and all its Strikes against the target. The penalty is -4 if an expert in Diplomacy, -6 if master, and -8 if legendary.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4evo0jTAKBhowyDG]{Empowered Onslaught}

The chosen battle aura's status bonus or penalty increases by 1, to a maximum of 4.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.6RAHnACKReBW68Sa]{Вторгнення присутності}

Легка віддача Ви стаєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Зляканими 3}.

Помірна віддача Усі істоти стають для вас @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Прихованими}, оскільки їх огортають зорові спотворення, які бачите лише ви.

Сильна віддача Ви стаєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Приреченими 1} та @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Виснаженими 2} до наступних щоденних приготувань.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.6RAHnACKReBW68Sa]{Encroaching Presence}

Mild Backlash You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Moderate Backlash All creatures become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you as they are covered in visual distortions only you can see.

Severe Backlash You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} until your next daily preparations.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BQzExsEZrwGsJD66]{Endemic Herbs}

You gain a benefit matching the location where the item was created.

  • Aquatic You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.
  • Forest You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against disease and poison effects.
  • Mountain You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.
  • Plains You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.
  • Underground You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception.

description.translate: Ціль зазнала впливу @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bp0Up04x3dzGK5bB]{Виснажливого удару} пройдисвіта, якщо пройдисвіт також має @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RzfWrOqHL2GcK0rr]{Тривале виснаження}.
description.original: The target has been affected by a rogue's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bp0Up04x3dzGK5bB]{Debilitating Strike} if the rogue also has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RzfWrOqHL2GcK0rr]{Enduring Debilitation}.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8PjTI21Mif26XWY7]{Енергетичний розпад}

Легка віддача Ви отримуєте @Damage[(@actor.level)[untyped]]{шкоду, що дорівнює вашому рівню}, коли енергія пронизує ваше тіло.

Помірна віддача Після отримання шкоди ви набуваєте слабкості до типу енергії своєї віддачі до наступних щоденних приготувань. Слабкість дорівнює третині вашого рівня. Ви також втрачаєте імунітет до цього типу енергії, якщо мали його, до наступних щоденних приготувань.

Сильна віддача Ви завдаєте @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[untyped]]{1d6 шкоди за кожен рівень} усім істотам у @Template[emanation|distance:30] із базовим спаскидком @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic]. Ви автоматично отримуєте повну шкоду без спаскидка.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8PjTI21Mif26XWY7]{Energetic Meltdown}

Mild Backlash You take @Damage[(@actor.level)[untyped]]{damage equal to your level} as energy scours your body.

Moderate Backlash After taking the damage, you gain weakness to the energy type of your backlash until your next daily preparations. The weakness is equal to one-third of your level. You also lose immunity to the energy type if you had it, until your next daily preparations.

Severe Backlash You deal @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[untyped]]{1d6 damage per level} to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save. You automatically take full damage without attempting a save.

Granted by Energize Bite

Your jaws unarmed attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of a type matching that of your draconic benefactor.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cmhfYMEM4uzrNIiV]{Наситити крила енергією}

Ви отримуєте Швидкість польоту 30 футів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cmhfYMEM4uzrNIiV]{Energize Wings}

You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iS4Vc2zv7vgL5mnX]{Energy Ablation}

You gain resistance to an energy damage type of your choice equal to the spell's rank.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TSDbyYRQwhIyY2Oq]{Energy Shot}

On your first three Strikes of this encounter with a firearm or crossbow, you deal an additional 1 acid, cold, fire or electricity damage. You choose which damage type to deal as part of making each Strike.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lG4dYrnkE42IgnGG]{Energy Ward}

You gain resistance to one type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void) equal to 4 + the rank of the spell.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.g0C3tqGjgShoDyif]{Дотримуватися клятви}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до КЗ і спаскидків проти атак та ефектів обраної істоти. Ви також отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до кидків атаки проти обраної істоти.

Ви також отримуєте статусний штраф –1 до КЗ, кидків атаки та спаскидків проти всіх інших істот, доки не припините Дотримуватися клятви.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.g0C3tqGjgShoDyif]{Enforce Oath}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against attacks and effects by the chosen creature. You also gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against the chosen creature.

You also take a –1 status penalty to AC, attack rolls, and saves against all other creatures until you stop Enforcing your Oath.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GLHh9MWlcINLC6Q0]{Рушій руйнування}

Ваша конструктивна інновація отримує обставинний бонус +2 до кидків атаки.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GLHh9MWlcINLC6Q0]{Engine of Destruction}

Your construct innovation gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack rolls.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Igt8Ml5YIdxueMlF]{Enjoy the Show}

You take a circumstance penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you, or a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls targeting you.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ROnjdPMvH0vkkWjQ]{Просвітлена присутність}.

Ви та союзники в межах 15 футів від вас отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до спаскидків Волі проти ментальних ефектів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ROnjdPMvH0vkkWjQ]{Enlightened Presence}.

You and allies within 15 feet of you gain a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws against mental effects.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.djULKW76BbSoN3zb]{Enter Spirit Trance}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier, a +1 status bonus to Fortitude and Will saving throws, and your melee Strikes deal 1 additional spirit damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5bCZGpp9yFHXDz1j]{Entity's Resurgence}

You remain at 1 Hit Point and gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level + your key ability modifier. However, the entity is in control. While the entity is in control, you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IY86Kvopp4ACuQsw]{Envenom Fangs}

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.60o2Pf4IunqP6J0Z]{Equitable Defense}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on the next Strike you make against the marked creature.

You create a torch-like flame. If you create a flame on a weapon, you still need to use it as an improvised weapon to attack with the flame, just as with a torch.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ccLpjnWjl62Ehegc]{Even the Odds (Eagle Knight)}

You gain 25 temporary Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5HDBvVbfoaXljbch]{Even the Odds}

You gain panache.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8YIA0jh64Ecz0TG6]{Desecration}

Each enemy in your champion's aura takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against you.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.uptzvOLrZ3fctrl2]{Exalted Reaction}

You grant the resistance to yourself and all allies in your champion's aura, including the triggering ally. If you do, the resistance is reduced by 2 for all.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.KxpaxUSuBC7hr4F7]{Exemplary Finisher}

The foe takes a -10 circumstance penalty to its speed until the start of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.KxpaxUSuBC7hr4F7]{Exemplary Finisher}

The foe takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against you until the start of your next turn.

name.original: Effect: Expel Maelstrom (Failure or Critical Failure)

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IV8sgoLO6ShD3DCJ]{Expel Maelstrom}

The creature takes a -2 status penalty to all saving throws and skill checks for 10 minutes.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IV8sgoLO6ShD3DCJ]{Expel Maelstrom}

The creature must roll twice and take the lower result on its next saving throw or skill check.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you have a free hand or are wielding a weapon with the parry trait.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Em5gwwyVHql9cSW2]{Eye-Catching Spot}

You have a –1 circumstance penalty to melee attack rolls against the exemplar.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OtV7esAwza1U6Kwr]{Око арклордів}

Ви отримуєте темнозір і статусний бонус +2 до перевірок Сприйняття для Пошуку невиявлених і схованих істот, а також до свого КС Сприйняття проти Сховатися та Прокрастися.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OtV7esAwza1U6Kwr]{Eye of the Arclords}

You gain darkvision and a +2 status bonus to Perception checks to Seek undetected and hidden creatures and to your Perception DC against Hide and Sneak.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tFoInIrUkGlWeNFF]{Face Your Fears}

You gain +1 circumstance bonus against fear effects.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.6ZmgkMHUGGb1mDhr]{Familiar of Balanced Luck}

You gain either a +1 status bonus to its AC or a –1 status penalty to your AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.HNoR0D2sKQaDNh5Z]{Familiar of Bolstering Aid}

You gain a +2 status bonus to the next non-attack skill check you attempt.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.onye3PN84lmca11D]{Familiar of Keen Senses}

Your familiar gains your choice of an imprecise scent, tremorsense, or wavesense, with a range of 60 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.ZCze1FY3Rmnvd6Dx]{Familiar of Restored Spirit}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to 2 + half the caster's level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BQ50m0Jb9qyoPchi]{Familiar's Resolve}

You gain a status bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OK8Fm7EG8wjoYZBX]{Сприятливі вітри}

Якщо крок дистанції вашої зброї становить 10 футів або менше, збільште його на 10 футів для цього Удару.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OK8Fm7EG8wjoYZBX]{Favorable Winds}

If your weapon has a range increment of 10 feet or less, increase its range increment by 10 feet for that Strike.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain (Forest, Moutain or Underground)} if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RlwE99yKnhq8FUuy]{Wild Stride} class feature, and are in forested, mountainous or underground terrain and do not already have a climb Speed.

You gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain (Aquatic)} if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RlwE99yKnhq8FUuy]{Wild Stride} class feature, and are in aquatic terrain and do not already have a swim Speed.

You gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain (Forest, Moutain or Underground)} if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RlwE99yKnhq8FUuy]{Wild Stride} class feature, and are in forested, mountainous or underground terrain and already have a climb Speed.

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your climb Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain (Aquatic)} if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RlwE99yKnhq8FUuy]{Wild Stride} class feature, and are in aquatic terrain and already have a swimSpeed.

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your swim Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.twx7XDGabYJz92mD]{Fear No Pain!}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to reroll a failed save.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.K3hd3w20M707t6Iq]{Feral Swing}

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your Reflex save.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.eW3cfCH7Wpx2vik2]{Родовід: Фейський}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до перевірок Виконавства.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.eW3cfCH7Wpx2vik2]{Bloodline: Fey}

You gain a +2 status bonus to Performance checks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.eNZnx4LISDNftbx2]{Chirurgeon}

The creature gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your Intelligence modifier.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VAIr1TpHZdxWovqG]{Fiendish Brand}

Anytime you cast a holy spell while the bleed damage persists, you must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the spell is disrupted.

description.translate: Ви можете напружитися, щоб витягнути зі спини крила, схожі на кажанячі чи інші диявольські, на вигляд схожі на крила ваших диявольських предків. Після прояву ці крила залишаються протягом 10 хвилин. Ви отримуєте швидкість польоту, що дорівнює вашій наземній швидкості, поки ви розкриваєте крила.
description.original: You can strain to call forth bat-like or otherwise fiendish wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your fiendish ancestors. Once manifested, these wings remain for 10 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed while you've manifested your wings.

name.original: Effect: Fish From the Falls' Edge

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tv0TX0DiDg2lDMOl]{Fish From the Falls' Edge}

You gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws and AC.

description.translate:
Надається, коли ви використовуєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SAOtGk9k8veaX3Ww]{Епатажну жорстокість}

Коли ви виконуєте Удар рукопашною зброєю по ворогу, який має щонайменше два з таких станів — Незграбний, Виснажений, Ослаблений, Зляканий, Нудота та Притуплений, — ви отримуєте обставинний бонус до кидка шкоди, що дорівнює кількості цих станів у ворога.

Якщо ви влучаєте по такому ворогу, то до кінця свого ходу отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до перевірок навичок для Прослизнути та виконання дій свого стилю, які надають панаш.
description.original:
Granted when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SAOtGk9k8veaX3Ww]{Flamboyant Cruelty}

When you make a melee weapon Strike against a foe that has at least two of the following conditions - Clumsy, Drained, Enfeebled, Frightened, Sickened, and Stupefied - you gain a circumstance bonus to your damage roll equal to the number of these conditions the foe has.

If you hit such a foe, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to Tumble Through and to perform your style's Panache-granting actions until the end of your turn.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SVdYJW5JsOMhAYd0]{Стрімкий темп}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +10 футів до всіх Швидкостей.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SVdYJW5JsOMhAYd0]{Fleet Tempo}

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds.

You are off-guard and take 1d8 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die of whichever weapon the origin used has the most weapon damage dice.

The enemy must roll its attack twice and take the lower result.

You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed and resistance to precision damage equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jIL0dobpVmCrmSj1]{Force of Nature}

Your fast healing deactivates.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UJafwv306v75Syy7]{Forcible Energy}

The target gains weakness 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage.

Granted by Form a Flock

You are dazzled.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aoz9dCq2NynyUYEf]{Тренування строю}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до КЗ і спаскидків. Для спаскидків Рефлексу проти ефектів області цей бонус збільшується до +2.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aoz9dCq2NynyUYEf]{Formation Training}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 on Reflex saves against area effects.

description.translate:

Ви Піднімаєте щит. Додайте рівень свого персонажа до Твердості щита.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DidzozerKLZ2UYLx]{Fortify Shield}

You Raise your Shield. Add your character level to your shield's Hardness.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xdqSgSfybmBOCw5q]{Fortunate Blow}

You roll twice on your next attack roll against the marked target and take the higher result.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IcAEMf94XoTvtzAO]{Fresh Produce}

You gain resistance to void damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.o3J79hnr00ztcwtT]{Fulminating Shot}

Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. If you hit with your next attack roll using a firearm or crossbow before the end of your turn, you deal 1d6 additional damage of this type. At 12th level, this increases to 2d6 additional damage, and at 18th level, it increases to 3d6 additional damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZYAn8X0IjA6i38qU]{Fungal Rot}

Mild Backlash You take damage equal to your level as your body decays.

Moderate Backlash You take damage equal to your level and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Severe Backlash You take damage equal to twice your level and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4}. You can't reduce the value of your sickened condition below 1 for 1 hour.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5gnBhockV7O32jTR]{Furious Finish}

You gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of rounds remaining in your Rage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6vHkvQv0j56nZuR3]{Furnace Form}

You gain fire immunity, resistance 10 to precision damage, weakness 5 to cold and to water, and a fly Speed of 40 feet. Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage.

Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 additional fire damage, and your fire spells deal one additional die of fire damage (of the same damage die the spell uses). Your fire Elemental Blasts deal an additional die of damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CowQy8gXP9POjuxq]{Game Hunter Dedication}

Your Speeds are each reduced by 10 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CowQy8gXP9POjuxq]{Game Hunter Dedication}

Your Speeds are each reduced by 10 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.O5EQnF6Iqs8uD64X]{Gather Disciples}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the first skill check you attempt when acting on the favor.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yg02rHaDPpGSgkrk]{Gathering Moss}

You gain fast healing equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tYOMBiH3HbViNWwn]{Bloodline: Genie}

Either you gain a +1 status bonus to Deception checks for 1 round, or a target takes a -1 status penalty to Perception for 1 round.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WcvscJpQhbTiefwn]{Geobukseon Retaliation}

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 2 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pM0g4ColXTiQ3gTa]{Ghost Strike}

The weapon gains the effects of the ghost touch property rune. At 10th level, you can apply this effect to two weapons instead of one.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.00OnDt8UEMwfoYWH]{Приборкувач привидів}

Ваші кулаки отримують ефект руни властивості дотику до привидів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.00OnDt8UEMwfoYWH]{Ghost Wrangler}

Your fists gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ABL4daQ7c65d0tEM]{Ghosts in the Storm}

You are concealed, and your Strikes gain the shock rune.

You gain a +2 status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MFqFvuiYDAoADcft]{Випад велетня}

Уся ваша рукопашна зброя та беззбройні атаки отримують досяжність 10 футів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MFqFvuiYDAoADcft]{Giant's Lunge}

All your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain reach 10.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W21jKAcG0GtEtBiK]{Статура велетня}

Ви стаєте Великими, збільшуєте свою досяжність на 5 футів і отримуєте стан @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Незграбний 1}, доки не припините Лють
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W21jKAcG0GtEtBiK]{Giant's Stature}

You become Large, increasing your reach by 5 feet and gaining the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} condition until you stop raging

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pGIJ6iXyg2CRzQxb]{Gird Champion}

You treat the origin's favored weapon as a simple weapon for the purposes of proficiency, you gain the critical specialization effect of that weapon and deal 1d6 additional damage with Strikes made with it.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dm0YMEvSY0qg0jA0]{Gladiator Dedication}

You gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yfl6q6Pi42FttDRE]{Glimpse Vulnerability}

You gain weakness 2 to the origin's unarmed and weapon Strikes.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.8CZwqRQ1w8OaAtO7]{(Affinity Ablaze) Biting Roses: Glimpses to Beyond}

You gain spiritsense as a precise sense with a range of 60 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TrE7lZdKLrWzbyoZ]{Glorious Banner}

You take a –2 status penalty to Will saves as long as you can see the origin's banner.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hXYnwpi95E77qfAu]{Goading Feint}

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against the opponent.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QZb0Utg0WFPf2Qg0]{Goblin Song}

The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QZb0Utg0WFPf2Qg0]{Goblin Song}

The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZuKEEP4S4b4fbgAt]{Gods' Palm}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Mw4owPxaU6i2Dpgl]{Godspeed}

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and are Quickened.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ysXXa8K9fa383HAD]{Great Bear}

You gain the effects of an enlarge spell.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ABXUfGoeBgCyFasg]{Велика форма тенґу}

Ви також отримуєте переваги заклять 4-го рангу @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Збільшення} та @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Політ}.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ABXUfGoeBgCyFasg]{Great Tengu Form}

You also gain the benefits of 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} spells.

Granted by Grief's Fury

You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls against any creature that attacked or dealt damage to your bonded partner.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JdCRxwgtdQkJ1Ha6]{Відхилення захисника (Воїн)} або @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YJIzE2RhGRGfbt9j]{Відхилення захисника (Шибайголова)}.

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до КЗ проти тригерної атаки.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JdCRxwgtdQkJ1Ha6]{Guardian's Deflection (Fighter)} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YJIzE2RhGRGfbt9j]{Guardian's Deflection (Swashbuckler)}.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fJxIdcg7kWPwlULY]{Обійми захисника}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до КЗ проти фізичних атак і можете використати реакцію, щоб отримати опір 10 до фізичної шкоди від цієї атаки, після чого цей ефект завершується.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fJxIdcg7kWPwlULY]{Guardian's Embrace}

You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical attacks and can use a reaction to gain resistance 10 to physical damage dealt by that attack, which ends this effect.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ek1CoyGKxsozDsaD]{Guide the Timeline}

If you are an ally, the next time you make an attack roll or skill check, roll it twice and take the higher result. If you are a foe, the next time you make an attack roll or skill check, you must roll twice and take the lower result.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.s1swBWSqtfrXTJHK]{Ведомий зорями}

Під час наступної перевірки навички або спаскидка ви кидаєте двічі й використовуєте кращий результат. Якщо зараз ніч і ви бачите зорі, ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до тригерного кидка.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.s1swBWSqtfrXTJHK]{Guided by the Stars}

You roll twice and take the better result on your next skill check or saving throw. If it's night and you can see the stars, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.x7EGJYZQuxHbP50X]{Скерована навичка}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до перевірок Акробатики, Окультизму, Скритності або Виживання.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.x7EGJYZQuxHbP50X]{Guided Skill}

You gain a +2 status bonus to checks made using Acrobatics, Occultism, Stealth, or Survival.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3OHdjgDGn4yzMD9b]{Guiding Shot}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus against the marked target, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the origin's Strike was a critical hit.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.LmsjuqB3rrZTqqa6]{Guiding Words}

Roll twice and use the better result on your first attack roll.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jwjtxZL6XpkO5lv9]{Guillotine Blade}

Your spectral dagger gains the effects of a vorpal rune.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FbzbZc4LGUTcz9tA]{Gunpowder Gauntlet}

You take a penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than the origin.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.O0uXZRWMNliDbkxU]{Родовід: Відьомський}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють рангу закляття.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.O0uXZRWMNliDbkxU]{Bloodline: Hag}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.s2GbcUIXG1ZBurSd]{Удар по сухожиллю}

Ви отримуєте статусний штраф –5 футів до Швидкості. За критичного влучання ви отримуєте статусний штраф –10 футів до Швидкості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.s2GbcUIXG1ZBurSd]{Hamstringing Strike}

You take a –5-foot status penalty to Speed. On a critical hit, you take a –10-foot status penalty to Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KuLH3nG3chToIffB]{Harbinger's Armament}

Select one weapon or handwraps of mighty blows. It gains the effect of one property rune. Choose either fearsome, ghost touch, returning, shifting, or vitalizing.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Z91dIlVcJXoicbHj]{Greater Armament}, add brilliant, corrosive, flaming, frost, holy, shock, thundering, and unholy.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.REgTwIVgI3j1FQiJ]{Harden Flesh}

You gain resistance 3 to physical damage, except adamantine, until the beginning of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.X1YhwDic2ugT9RuQ]{Harrow-Chosen}

This benefit is determined by alignment of the card you draw from the deck. The card can match both alignment components with yours (true match), match a single alignment component with yours (partial match), have no matching alignment components (unmatched), or have a diametrically opposed alignment to yours (misaligned).

True match: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to a saving throw of your choice (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will) for 1 minute.

Partial match: You gain resistance to one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) equal to your level for 1 minute.

Unmatched: You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level. The temporary Hit Points remain for 1 minute.

Misaligned: You gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds for 1 minute.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0i4zOM1p0rFxnc5m]{Harrower Dedication}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JoZRbbexF3epeREe]{Benevolent Spirit Deck}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.nqEqvZviKYuGVxLV]{Restore Omen}

Draw a card from your harrow deck—that card's suit becomes your active harrow omen.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EuoCFSHTzi0VOfuf]{Вразити потвору}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до всіх Ударів або кидків атаки закляттям проти потвор.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EuoCFSHTzi0VOfuf]{Harrow the Fiend}

You gain a +1 status bonus on all Strikes or spell attack rolls against fiends.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.37uOb0iaWCfTCvBZ]{Суворий вирок}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до перевірок Сприйняття, щоб Шукати засудженого ворога, і до перевірок Залякування, щоб Деморалізувати його. Ви отримуєте обставинний штраф –1 до перевірок Сприйняття, щоб Шукати інших істот, і до перевірок Залякування, щоб Деморалізувати когось, крім засудженого ворога.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.37uOb0iaWCfTCvBZ]{Harsh Judgement}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek your condemned foe and on Intimidation checks to Demoralize them. You have a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks to Seek creatures other than your condemned foe and on Intimidation checks to Demoralize anyone other than your condemned foe.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GrzbczH9S3SHPiIQ]{Harvest Blood}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier, and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against that creature's spells.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Rb3ndqSyDUa6KvOL]{Hasty Celebration}

You grant all allies within 60 feet a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and damage, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to all enemies.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.xSgUH97WkWadielz]{Healer of the World}

You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cD5EsurWVYekIXkz]{Healing Sanctuary}

You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qJdbK8vgIqeHU7bu]{Грім небес}

Ваші беззбройні атаки та будь-яка зброя монаха, якою ви володієте, завдають додаткової шкоди електрикою та звуком; кількість кожного типу шкоди дорівнює кількості кісток шкоди зброї або беззбройної атаки.

Якщо ви також знаєте закляття ці вибух ці, можете обрати, щоб воно завдавало шкоди електрикою або звуком замість силової шкоди (вибух ці втрачає трейт сили й натомість отримує трейт електрики або звуку).
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qJdbK8vgIqeHU7bu]{Heaven's Thunder}

Your unarmed attacks and any monk weapons you wield deal additional electricity and sonic damage; the amount of each damage type is equal to the number of damage dice for the weapon or unarmed attack.

If you also know the qi blast qi spell, you can choose to deal either electricity or sonic damage with the spell instead of force (qi blast loses the force trait and gains the electricity or sonic trait instead).

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.24LBBYT1op52Pm4J]{Hellbreaker's Resolve}.

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. While you have those temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.
When you critically succeed at a skill check to Recall Knowledge about a devil or Hellknight, you gain a +4 status bonus to damage against that creature for 1 minute.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qUSWPWxYF8gfhfHM]{Helpful Tinkering}

Your strikes with the chosen weapon gain the same offensive boost your inventor ally's innovation has.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9tXGk4h9Bw3Wcnra]{Helt's Spelldance}

You take a –1 circumstance penalty to your saving throws against any spell the origin casts.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5ELeiNtEDgXfBcwt]{Herald's Weapon}

Your chosen weapon or unarmed attack deals spirit damage instead of its regular damage, it gains the sanctified trait, and deals an additional 2d4 spirit damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7cM7uKRKQDWz5eeu]{Заклик героїв}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють подвоєному вашому рівню.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7cM7uKRKQDWz5eeu]{Heroes' Call}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.81jVmGF9Uo9dp2dI]{Heroic Defiance}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +1 status bonus to all saving throws.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KR78kinMmAZQHeoa]{Героїчне відновлення}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +5 футів до своєї Швидкості та статусний бонус +1 до кидків атаки й шкоди.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KR78kinMmAZQHeoa]{Heroic Recovery}

You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC and Reflex saving throws against devils and creatures allied with the Chelaxian government (as determined by the GM) until the beginning of your next turn.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xDTjr415ZZM8x2WW]{Швидкісна регенерація}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +10 футів до своєї Швидкості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xDTjr415ZZM8x2WW]{High-Speed Regeneration}

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GU3EQVOMjD9S2YWj]{Hone Claws}

Your claws deal an additional 1d6 bleed damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.heritages.Item.yEQSw61sNRvgPy4T]{Hopeful Athamaru}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dtPXuS8MiWrz5UNK]{Hot Foot}

You are off-guard and take a -2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rb0GCneYEzBi2LGr]{Howling Aspect}

You gain a tusks melee unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the finesse and unarmed traits. You also gain a flame-hair melee unarmed attack that deals 1d4 fire damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6nB5ycSo4zshj22k]{Hungry Blade}

Your spectral dagger gains the effects of a keen property rune that applies only to Strikes against the target of the required Strike.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DnfVQGLk3PAl8UWh]{Голодний гоблін}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють половині вашого рівня.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DnfVQGLk3PAl8UWh]{Hungry Goblin}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey}

You mark a creature as your prey.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.I6gG9rqTTLkzrhKF]{Hunt Runelord}

Choose a Thassilonian rune school. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when you seek a creature that serves these ideals and a +2 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks made to Demoralize such creatures. Your Strikes also deal 1d4 extra precision to these creatures when they're frightened.

Ephemeral effect for

You take a a –1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against spells or effects created by the originating actor. This penalty increases to –2 against effects that have the holy trait.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek or Sense the Motive of the marked creature. This creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against spells or effects you create. This penalty increases to –2 against effects that have the holy trait.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GFtNQvpzuqtsdOTG]{Hunter's Aim} via Ephemeral Effect

Your lesser cover is ignored by the origin's ranged attack roll.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Змінити форму}.

У гібридній формі ви виглядаєте як поєднання свого походження та притаманної вам тварини. Перебуваючи в гібридній формі, ви отримуєте беззбройний Удар щелепами, що нагадує особливості притаманної вам тварини (ікла кажана, дзьоб орла, жвали оси тощо). Ваші щелепи завдають 1d4 колючої шкоди, мають трейти швидкий, спритний і беззбройний та належать до кулачної групи зброї.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape}.

In hybrid shape, you appear as a mix between your ancestry and your inherent animal. While in hybrid shape, you gain a jaws unarmed Strike resembling the features of your inherent animal (fangs for bats, beaks for eagles, mandibles for wasps, and so on). Your jaws deal 1d4 piercing damage, have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits, and are in the brawling weapon group.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.kqRFoXfErUFEndIs]{Гідравлічне відхилення}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до КЗ.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.kqRFoXfErUFEndIs]{Hydraulic Deflection}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZEtJJ5UOlV5oTWWp]{Родовід: Імперський}

На свій вибір ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до КЗ або статусний бонус +1 до спаскидків.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZEtJJ5UOlV5oTWWp]{Bloodline: Imperial}

You gain your choice of either a +1 status bonus to AC or a +1 status bonus to saving throws.

description.translate: Застосовується, коли ви наносите отруту, створену за допомогою @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9Eufa07qvXG41QmG]{Покращеної отруєної зброї}.
description.original: Applied when you apply a poison created with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9Eufa07qvXG41QmG]{Improved Poison Weapon}.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1RQLf09kpOO6ljmb]{In Lightning, Life}

You gain temporary Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.v84501yLBubHlGPz]{Indomitable Spirit}

You get a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and are quickened. The additional action can be used to Strike or Stride.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Nm4yeoJVXRy0Wyth]{Inertial Barrier}

You gain resistance to physical damage equal to 2 + the spell's rank.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UxjAszOYAhUvCDt2]{Inescapable Grasp}

If you attempt to use a teleportation spell or effect while grabbed, you must succeed at a DC 15 flat check or the spell fails.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DaRfJsWAivah3a07]{Infused with Belkzen's Might}

You deal additional spirit damage with weapons and unarmed attacks equal to 1 plus half the number of Tattooed Historian feats you have.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ZXvJGxMJc0HRpcQh]{Натхненна стратегія}

Ви двічі кидаєте тригерну перевірку й використовуєте кращий із двох результатів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ZXvJGxMJc0HRpcQh]{Inspired Stratagem}

You roll the triggering check twice and take the better of the two results.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bvOsJNeI0ewvQsFa]{Стійка надихаючого маршала}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до кидків атаки та спаскидків проти ментальних ефектів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bvOsJNeI0ewvQsFa]{Inspiring Marshal Stance}

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.c2UuV5n5leFx9vlU]{Inspiring Recitation}

You gain a status bonus to one skill of your choice. If you're an expert in Performance, the bonus increases to +2. If you're a master in Performance, the bonus is +3, and if you're legendary, the bonus is +4.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AbsqV1P8OAhChcRl]{Надихаюча стійкість}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до спаскидка Волі проти тригерного ефекту або обставинний бонус +2, якщо ефект походить від нежиті.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AbsqV1P8OAhChcRl]{Inspiring Resilience}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Will save against the triggering effect, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the effect originated from an undead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6TlBZSPr18Y8WiNk]{Instructive Strike}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check to Recall Knowledge.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.d2InKGKNEdVnPfNf]{Instrument of Death}

Choose one:

  • You can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses.

  • You gain weakness 10 to spirit damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0bFXHrLuMKcuz9DD]{Invented Vulnerability}

You gain weakness to the selected damage type.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SrSYEHqOLXWuj65e]{Inventive Offensive}

When you use this ability, add one of the following weapon traits to a melee weapon you wield: deadly d6, disarm, nonlethal, shove, trip, versatile B, versatile P, or versatile S. You cannot add a trait that the weapon already has. The weapon retains this trait until you a successfully hit and deal damage with the weapon. The weapon retains this trait only while you wield it, and you can have only one weapon modified in this way at any time.

If you have legendary proficiency in Crafting, you can apply two weapon traits from the list when using this feat.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.23QgyEYjoslBvkra]{Підбадьорливе дихання}

Ви отримуєте 20 тимчасових ОЗ. На 15-му рівні ви натомість отримуєте 30 тимчасових ОЗ.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.23QgyEYjoslBvkra]{Invigorating Breath}

You gain 20 temporary Hit Points. At 15th level, you instead gain 30 temporary Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mMboqxWsQmwUTQ6m]{Invigorating Surge}

You gain temporary Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2zxF682cNhgLMu26]{Invincible Army}

You gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage if the check was against the hard DC. if the check is against a very hard DC, then you gain resistance to two damage types, adding acid, fire, cold, electricity, and sonic to the damage types.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iBdvNOWazhiXeUUa]{Invoke Defense}

Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. You gain resistance equal to half your level to that damage type.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7ZYw4SiBLBbbICNs]{Invoke Movement}

You gain a burrow, climb, fly or swim speed equal to your Speed (or half your Speed if you selected burrow).

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EEtezGRTZSHayQDR]{Invoke Offense}

You gain an unarmed attack that deals 1d8 spirit damage for the duration of your spirit trance.This unarmed attack is in the brawling weapon group and has the agile, finesse, and magical traits.

At 5th level, this unarmed attack gains the benefits of a striking rune. At 12th level, this unarmed attack gains the benefits of a greater striking rune. At 20th level, this unarmed attack gains the benefits of a major striking rune.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RmAl2BfBkFj8RC1S]{Iomedae's Valor}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RmAl2BfBkFj8RC1S]{Iomedae's Valor}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

description.translate:
Доки ваші крила розгорнуті, ви отримуєте Швидкість польоту, що дорівнює вашій наземній Швидкості.

Якщо ви маєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UuVz1QY7QXD5cnLu]{Перший політ}, то отримуєте статусний бонус +10 футів до Швидкості польоту від Юнацького польоту. Як зазвичай, оскільки ваша Швидкість польоту походить від наземної Швидкості, цей статусний бонус не накопичується зі статусним бонусом до наземної Швидкості, якщо він у вас є.
description.original:
You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed while your wings are unfurled.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UuVz1QY7QXD5cnLu]{Fledgling Flight}, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed with Juvenile Flight. As normal, since your fly Speed is derived from your land Speed, this status bonus isn't cumulative with a status bonus to your land Speed, if you have one.

name.original: Effect: Keep Up the Good Fight

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xdv75qkv5TOFlHmM]{Keep up the Good Fight}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ySeT8hrMEPF9AsQu]{Kindle Inner Flames}

You gain a status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.gVPtUSEPZYGRIRyQ]{Kindling}

You gain a status bonus to the damage of a spell that has the fire trait equal to twice the spell rank.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.g8QrV39TmZfkbXgE]{Channel Elements}

You activate your kinetic aura.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zknpo51jJndv68Ph]{Kishin Rage}

You gain 40 temporary Hit Points, a fly Speed equal to your Speed, and your horns deal an additional 1d4 electricity damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1muxLx8Vacn2SLHc]{Kneecap}

The target takes a status penalty to its Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iWvpq3uDZcXvBJj8]{Known Weaknesses}.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against the marked creature.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.AltwHU7hCqTwpn48]{Lantern}

You gain gain a +1 status bonus to visual Perception checks to notice anything that is within the origin's bright light, and to checks to Recall Knowledge against creatures within the bright light.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OFCeTaAX99YbXOu0]{Lava Leap}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.nLFP7rT0jhM11nFR]{Lead by Example}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OZtoTusMmCJymObT]{Leech-Clip}

You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speed (or a –15-foot status penalty on a critical hit).

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7XA3Hm2md2tU9pEz]{Left-Hand Blood}

If you hit with the weapon and deal damage, the target also takes 1d4 persistent poison damage.

description.translate:
Надається @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YTTJqRKH8QZl6al2]{Мисливцем на монстрів}, якщо ви маєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Veyt4x2Kb5YcPGTv]{Легендарного мисливця на монстрів}.

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до наступного кидка атаки проти цієї здобичі.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YTTJqRKH8QZl6al2]{Monster Hunter} if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Veyt4x2Kb5YcPGTv]{Legendary Monster Hunter}.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

label.original: Target is the subject of Monster Hunter

description.translate:
Надається @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2yq3l8e2Vzz34yRV]{Охоронцем від монстрів}, якщо ви маєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Veyt4x2Kb5YcPGTv]{Легендарного мисливця на монстрів}.

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до наступного кидка атаки проти цієї здобичі.

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до наступного спаскидка проти цієї істоти та до КЗ проти наступної атаки цієї істоти по вас.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2yq3l8e2Vzz34yRV]{Monster Warden} if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Veyt4x2Kb5YcPGTv]{Legendary Monster Hunter}.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against that particular creature and to your AC against that creature's next attack against you.

label.original: Target is the subject of Monster Hunter

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DmpJgLsHfv1kMcJc]{Legendary Monster}

When you Unleash Yaoguai Might, you can gain one of the following additional benefits.

  • Your body grows to impossible heights. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} effect is heightened to 4th rank.
  • Your spiritual power erupts to punish your enemies. You deal an additional 1d4 spirit damage with all Strikes and attack spells, and your Strikes and attack spells gain the spirit trait.
  • You can leap off the air itself. You gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} spell.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8KxcNpQhmUOj3vuV]{Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication}

You roll your flat check to recover from persistent bleed damage twice and take the better result.

name.original: Effect: Lesson of the Broken Wing

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CyvXimmSlpbOlBhX]{Lesson of the Broken Wing}

If you're the origin, you take a –1 penalty to your AC against the marked creature's Strikes. Otherwise, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Strikes against the creature.

name.original: Effect: Lesson of the Splintered Aegis

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ry8NYQwxPagKnLKW]{Lesson of the Splintered Aegis}

You can roll your next Strike or spell attack roll against the target twice and take the better result.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.kF7dYvDYcoBABmLA]{Liberated Mind}

You gain a +2 status bonus to reroll a saving throw to avoid the confused or controlled conditions.

description.translate:
Надається Езотеричною клятвою (Визволитель)

Якщо ви використовуєте Визвольний крок, тригером якого стала зла аберація, ваш союзник отримує обставинний бонус +4 до перевірок, наданих Визвольним кроком, і після цього може двічі виконати Крок.
description.original:
Granted by Esoteric Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by an evil aberration, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

description.translate:
Надається Клятвою драконоборця (Визволитель)

Якщо ви використовуєте Визвольний крок, тригером якого став злий дракон, ваш союзник отримує обставинний бонус +4 до перевірок, наданих Визвольним кроком, і після цього може двічі виконати Крок.
description.original:
Granted by Dragonslayer Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by an evil dragon, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

description.translate:
Надається Клятвою погибелі потвор (Визволитель)

Якщо ви використовуєте Визвольний крок, тригером якого стала потвора, ваш союзник отримує обставинний бонус +4 до перевірок, наданих Визвольним кроком, і після цього може двічі виконати Крок.
description.original:
Granted by Fiendsbane Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by a fiend, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

description.translate:
Надається Сяйною клятвою (Визволитель)

Якщо ви використовуєте Визвольний крок, тригером якого стала нежить, ваш союзник отримує обставинний бонус +4 до перевірок, наданих Визвольним кроком, і після цього може двічі виконати Крок.
description.original:
Granted by Shining Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by an undead, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.XIk9Z4cLsoJRyV0T]{Life-Draining}

Mild Backlash You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} as the plants feed off your life force. This condition lasts until you spend 3 consecutive actions to rest and do nothing.

Moderate Backlash You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until you spend 20 minutes recuperating by resting and doing nothing. If you spend this time basking in sunshine, it instead takes 10 minutes.

Severe Backlash You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} until you spend 2 hours napping. While napping, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and can't take actions or engage in exploration activities, but a creature can wake you with a single action with the manipulate trait. If you spend this time napping in natural sunlight, it instead takes 1 hour. You're fatigued until you can get a full night's rest.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hSzNtRNwrma81Eeq]{Життєдайна магія}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють половині вашого рівня (щонайменше 1) і зберігаються до кінця вашого наступного ходу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hSzNtRNwrma81Eeq]{Life-Giving Magic}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.zwWgHjcU0iZ6gUDY]{Lightning Armillary}

Your weapon or hand deals an additional 1d6 electricity damage, or 1d8 electricity damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NKsNDA8rS9R5MmAX]{Living Epic}

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception, saving throws, and skill checks.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CL43gGiErw5FUtFQ]{Жити заради оплесків}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до КЗ.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CL43gGiErw5FUtFQ]{Living for the Applause}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9MJcQEMVVrmMyGyq]{Living Fortification}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.McnLGEZnUbtYCNDW]{Lock On}

You gain a circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the designated enemy.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.apz0n3Q3gWvQVChT]{Lord of the Fiends}

Whenever you roll a success on a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check against a fiend, you get a critical success instead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.d8RfatiK9UOQANLz]{Lost in the Crowd}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Stealth check when in a crowd of at least 10 creatures or a +4 circumstance bonus when in a crowd of at least 100 creatures.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Hmgy0GJKIawAiqHE]{Зцілення Діви}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють половині вашого рівня (щонайменше 1) і зберігаються до кінця вашого наступного ходу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Hmgy0GJKIawAiqHE]{Maiden's Mending}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IfWF56KiSFQbNmHj]{Manifest Realm}

You take a –1 penalty to Fortitude saving throws.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.k8c0E7YyeIQJjRzB]{Marked for Rebuke}

You gain weakness 10 to all damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MYzRfNExDYp25rro]{Посвята маршала}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до спаскидків проти страху.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MYzRfNExDYp25rro]{Marshal Dedication}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against fear.

Granted by Martyr's Parry

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.y8l4omYxEWH7vihP]{Meddling Futures}

Roll 1d4 to see what type of spirit is drawn to you. You gain the listed benefit for the action. If you attempt to use a different action, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] or the action is lost.

1 Warrior You must attempt a Strike. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll and a +2 status bonus to damage, or a +6 status bonus to damage if you are at least cursebound 3.

2 Adept You must attempt a Perception check or a skill action. You gain a +1 status bonus to the check, or a +2 status bonus if you are cursebound 3.

3 Sage You must attempt to Cast a Spell. You gain a status bonus to the spell's damage or healing equal to the spell's rank, or equal to the spell's rank + 3 if you are at least cursebound 3.

4 Wanderer You must attempt a Stride action, or a Fly, Climb, or Burrow action if you have the relevant speed. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed for the action, or a +20-foot status bonus if you are at least cursebound 3.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7UDWeLq8OAL04gHR]{Memory of Skill}

You temporarily increase your proficiency rank with that skill by one step.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pEFcWRYiWLSjxvkW]{Mental Balm}

You or one ally within 30 feet gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects for 1 minute.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JBjRGWVtVaxLckfH]{Mentor of Legends}

The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.syyT2xBA4H72TpOt]{Metallic Skin}

You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine), but you take a –10-foot penalty to Speed. If you take fire damage while this ability is active, until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional 2d6 fire damage with all your unarmed melee Strikes.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CkK7WwaWnrLXK9sW]{Methodical Debilitations}

You cannot gain a circumstance bonus to AC from Raising a Shield, lesser cover, or standard cover.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CkK7WwaWnrLXK9sW]{Methodical Debilitations}

You are unable to flank or provide flanking.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.lJAQPRT2t8IABR4v]{Mirrored Aegis}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EKEZGfOBKTNWTFDe]{Mirrored Wall}

You take a circumstance penalty to your Fortitude save.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IwETJ7fhszmlNo7X]{Moisture Bath}

You gain fire and cold resistance equal to half your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IzNyByUBNH94MDOr]{Fey Ascension}

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while you've manifested your wings.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YTTJqRKH8QZl6al2]{Мисливець на монстрів}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до наступного кидка атаки проти оціненої істоти. Цей бонус збільшується до +2, якщо джерело має Легендарного мисливця на монстрів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YTTJqRKH8QZl6al2]{Monster Hunter}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against the assessed creature. This bonus increases to +2 if the origin has Legendary Monster Hunter.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2yq3l8e2Vzz34yRV]{Охоронець від монстрів}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 або до КЗ під час наступної атаки оціненої істоти по вас, або до свого наступного спаскидка проти ефекту цієї істоти.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2yq3l8e2Vzz34yRV]{Monster Warden}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus either to your AC the next time the assessed creature attacks you or to your next saving throw against an effect from that particular creature.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UFn85K7uDsZj5Hep]{Mountain Strategy}

Marks a target that critically hit you.

description.translate: Ви зосереджуєтеся на своєму зв’язку із землею та закликаєте гору блокувати атаки проти вас. Ви отримуєте +2 бонус обставин до КБ до початку вашого наступного ходу.
description.original: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bAXkEXAlnBx78S7t]{Mountaineering Training}

You gain a climb Speed of 20 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.LBfLDfLnCFn1iy5h]{Multifaceted Will}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against spells with the chosen tradition trait.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tvdb1jkjl2bRZjSp]{Mutagenist}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Intelligence modifier plus half your level.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SWNmYaj0OSPhhIqO]{Мутувати зброю}

Кістка шкоди атаки, отриманої вами від Живої зброї, збільшується на один крок. Крім того, оберіть одне: атака отримує досяжність 10 футів, або ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до кидків атаки обраною беззбройною атакою.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SWNmYaj0OSPhhIqO]{Mutate Weapon}

The damage die for the attack you gained with Living Weapon increases by one step. In addition, choose to either have the attack gain a reach of 10 feet or for you to gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with the chosen unarmed attack.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Lx7JtAhIn3aJ6WbP]{Mythic Allies}

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Lx7JtAhIn3aJ6WbP]{Mythic Allies}

You gain a +2 status bonus to your attack rolls, defenses, and a number of additional Hit Points equal to the origin's level. The next Strike you make gains a +4 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JS24EjgLYcHB9E3T]{Nanite Surge}.

You gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering skill check.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JS24EjgLYcHB9E3T]{Сплеск нанітів}.

Ваші контури світяться, освітлюючи @Template[emanation|distance:10] тьмяним світлом на 1 раунд.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JS24EjgLYcHB9E3T]{Nanite Surge}.

Your circuitry glows, lighting a @Template[emanation|distance:10] with dim light for 1 round.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zuTNF3UEr0ZNleqR]{Naval Training}

You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gDvLmqxAtxY3LVaH]{Nothing Personal}

Your first strike each round deals an extra die of weapon damage to the marked target. This increases to 2 die at level 14, and 3 die at level 20.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5Wxjghw7lHuCxjZz]{Bloodline: Nymph}

You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks or a -1 status penalty on one target's Will saves for 1 round.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.imBsp1Tg7KMut4Lf]{Oath of the Defender}

You gain resistance to damage dealt by creatures with the chosen trait.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1gtWb6lKWMw1Wp1q]{Ocean's Balm}

You gain fire resistance.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.F8oXHnu9iNTcpXbJ]{Offensive Boost}

Your improvements make any Strikes that rely on your innovation deal an additional 1d6 damage, with a type determined by the boost you choose. If your innovation is armor, the boost applies to your melee Strikes with one weapon you choose during daily preparations; if your innovation is a construct, the boost applies to your construct companion's Strikes.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7wQe43fSCG9DSWdj]{Offer Story}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and Will saves.

If the origin has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yRT94fGPaS1M9f9I]{Illuminating Stories}, then you can choose to gain a status bonus on skill checks to Recall Knowledge instead.

If the origin has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3GmgFUL2xzt5vhCz]{Raging Stories}, you can choose to deal additional fire damage with your melee Strikes instead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IEBBHnI7wWRt44KG]{One Moment till Glory}

You gain a +2 status bonus to your saving throw.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OxdlGZ1rndxalf6X]{One with the Spirits}

You gain fast healing 5 and you become concealed. Your Strikes gain the benefits of a ghost touch property rune. Whenever you deal damage with a Strike, you can choose to have that Strike deal spirit damage, rather than its usual damage type.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MRMW0EiuOO20pzG2]{Ongoing Selfishness}

You gain resistance to all further damage from the triggering enemy until the end of the turn on which you used the reaction. This resistance is equal to half your Selfish Shield resistance.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iCNNMJeGvsIzza4A]{Oni Form}

Your size increases to Large, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. This doesn't change your Speed, reach, or other statistics except as noted here.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8r9ePG6BnrnO6YE1]{Only You and I}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls made against the exemplar. Whenever you miss the exemplar with a Strike, they heal 1d8+5 Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Gcliatty0MGYbTVV]{Oracular Warning}

Each ally gains a +2 status bonus to their initiative roll. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Oracular Warning, the bonus increases to +3, and if you are cursebound 3, the bonus increases to +4.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Gcliatty0MGYbTVV]{Oracular Warning}

Each ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cbEodcnBKzx5ii3B]{Orchard's Endurance}

You gain resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage. In addition, you roll flat checks to recover from persistent damage twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xCi23uEFef9jhtlM]{Overclock Senses}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against ranged attacks and to Reflex saving throws.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.U0XX0Mm2MbZcuNK2]{Shared Overdrive}

The first time you use Overdrive Ally during a given Overdrive, the effect lasts for the remainder of the duration of your Overdrive, instead of just until the end of the target's next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NBvhmNqneeok7ZOr]{Overdrive Ally}

Your Strikes deal additional damage equal to half your Intelligence modifier, or your full Intelligence modifier if you were in critical overdrive.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3D9kGfwg4LUZBR9A]{Overdrive}

Your Strikes deal additional damage equal to your Intelligence modifier on a critical success, or half your Intelligence modifier on a success. On a failure, your Strikes deal 1 additional fire damage instead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9CaaU5szcf3mtJXD]{Overextending Feint}

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against the opponent.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tIE2umG4rQOxm8D8]{Oversized Throw}

You gain a ranged Strike. It is a simple ranged weapon that deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage, has a range increment of 20 feet, and has the thrown weapon trait. The damage increases to 2d10 bludgeoning damage if you have weapon specialization in simple weapons, or 3d10 bludgeoning if you have greater weapon specialization.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t03Tc5I4B8RHsyqs]{Посвята спостерігача}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до кидків ініціативи.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t03Tc5I4B8RHsyqs]{Overwatch Dedication}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.U1EMvL3PbEQZXqLy]{Packed with Flavor}

You gain temporary Hit Points.

name.original: Effect: Pact of the Final Breath

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qgahXDIjevUmk5Ci]{Pact of the Final Breath}

You gain fast healing equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.j5VRy2iVz5aulQ1h]{Pain is Temporary}

You gain resistance 10 to all damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qPlv8HwtoO2fAjkj]{Pale Horse}

You gain resistance 10 to fire, poison, or void damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TnYHtN9gQASqOnii]{Flashy Dodge}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WcY7H7mRiK2VDquV]{Extravagant Parry} via Ephemeral Effect.

If your Strike misses, the origin gains panache.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TnYHtN9gQASqOnii]{Flashy Dodge}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WcY7H7mRiK2VDquV]{Extravagant Parry}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C5tSxOwDILefw4zq]{Elegant Buckler}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DkoxNw9tsFFXrfJY]{Charmed Life}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YJIzE2RhGRGfbt9j]{Guardian's Deflection}, and bravado actions on a failure.

You gain panache.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Панаш}

Ви отримуєте панаш.
