description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache}

You gain panache.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lL5MxRUFqbzS6jDm]{Pass Vengeful Judgment}

You gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks against creatures in the area within a 10-mile radius of where Pass Vengeful Judgment was used.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.O0XJIvMGK36yg9TJ]{Path of the Tempest}

Your familiar summons winds that speed up and protect you. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed until the end of your turn. When you Stride this turn, you don't trigger reactions. In addition, you don't need to Stride before a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} this turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RaqjaXp2miOq4Bis]{Dragonet Breath}

If the origin's breath gives good luck, you gain a +1 status bonus to your next attack roll or skill check. If the origin's breath gives bad luck, you take a –1 status penalty to your next attack roll or skill check.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.J2KKsWrNR2tMqLFB]{Pennant of Victory}

You gain a +4 status bonus to attack and damage rolls, a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds, and 40 temporary Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oYzkopbXguiwfNTx]{Perfect Protection}

When you critically hit the origin, they roll a DC 14 flat check. On a success, it becomes a normal hit. If the origin's armor has a fortification rune, they roll only one flat check, but the DC is 12 (or 10 if it's a greater fortification rune).

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QN55ToyJIjxgPmhs]{Досконалий опір}

Після використання закляття ці Учня досконалості опір збільшується до вашого рівня на 1 раунд.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QN55ToyJIjxgPmhs]{Perfect Resistance}

After using a Student of Perfection ki spell, the resistance increases to be equal to your level for 1 round.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4YqmeJQwnrG1Lg07]{Phenom's Verve}

You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls with one-handed firearms and one-handed melee weapons.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TWR1wbPJuCLnGdFZ]{Bloodline: Phoenix}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.18eGaH5rWEXpDlgk]{Pierce the Eye}

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to Medicine checks to Administer First Aid to stop the bleeding.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XtIPmZ3Ihq5NJHP2]{Pinpoint Poisoner}

The creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its initial save against that poison.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yOyMlFGAgLfRas8m]{Pistolero's Challenge}

Both you and the opponent gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls with Strikes made against each other. If you're a master in the skill you used for the check, the status bonus to damage rolls increases to +3, and if you're legendary, it increases to +4.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.s6C5jtru8j0sONa6]{Plane-Stepping Dash}

You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xEeCaJsQeDtRAVk1]{Plant Banner}

You gain 4 temporary Hit Points, plus an additional 4 temporary Hit Points if the origin is 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

name.original: Effect: Play to the Crowd (AC Bonus)

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KrYvJ5n06yHCipCZ]{Play to the Crowd}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

name.original: Effect: Play to the Crowd (Attack Roll Bonus)

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KrYvJ5n06yHCipCZ]{Play to the Crowd}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll.

name.original: Effect: Play to the Crowd (Temporary Hit Points)

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KrYvJ5n06yHCipCZ]{Play to the Crowd}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your character level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xccOiNL2W1EtfUYl]{Pointed Question}

You gain a circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if the marked creature attempts to Lie to you, and the marked creature is off-guard to the Strike you make against it using Devise a Stratagem.

description.translate: Застосовується, коли ви наносите отруту, створену за допомогою @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ALbosSUygdq4T1Yk]{Отруєної зброї}.
description.original: Applied when you apply a poison created with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ALbosSUygdq4T1Yk]{Poison Weapon}.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rRbMOxX1QTHIIwAi]{Portentous Spell}.

Any creature that attempts to use a reaction triggered by your Cast a Spell activity takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and skill checks rolled as part of the reaction.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tz0gvfTwcDq0yEfg]{Portents of the Haruspex}

Roll 1d12 to determine the damage type. The next time before the end of your next turn that you or your allies deals that damage type to an enemy, that enemy has weakness equal to your level against that damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2qR4QAgJVArv63Z2]{Зброя, освячена молитвою}

Обрана зброя завдає додатково 1d6 життєвої шкоди.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2qR4QAgJVArv63Z2]{Prayer-Touched Weapon}

The chosen weapon deals an extra 1d6 vitality damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MlxfNv98LZKfYl64]{Precious Ammunition}

Choose cold iron or silver; if you shoot the arrow or bolt before the end of your turn, it counts as that material. At 14th level, add adamantine to the list of materials you can choose from.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wvJBIzgS298ZRp6w]{Precise Debilitations}

The target takes an additional 2d6 precision damage from your attacks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cErltcAC7OVnIyO1]{Predictable}

You gain a circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against the target. On a critical failure, you take a –1 circumstance penalty instead.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cErltcAC7OVnIyO1]{Передбачувано!}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус до КЗ і свого наступного спаскидка проти цілі. За критичної невдачі ви натомість отримуєте обставинний штраф –1.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cErltcAC7OVnIyO1]{Predictable!}

You gain a circumstance bonus to AC and your next saving throw against the target. On a critical failure, you take a –1 circumstance penalty instead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2h8a6pKhXTXwpJjP]{Premonition of Clarity}

Reroll the triggering saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NMbOfl885pn0Yzu9]{Prepare Elemental Medicine}

You gain a circumstance bonus to saves against an affliction, or a –1 circumstance penalty on a critical failure.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qaiwbAb1PaKrZ2O0]{Energy Fortification} and use Occultism to Prepare Elemental Medicine, the recipient gains resistance and weakness to vitality damage and void damage based on the element you chose.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Tf9RmqKU148OyQbz]{Prescience}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and all saves.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Xw7qG0SHepXx24vl]{Панівна позиція}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +4 до тригерного спаскидка або до КЗ проти тригерної атаки.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Xw7qG0SHepXx24vl]{Prevailing Position}

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw or to your AC against the triggering attack.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CCY6VsGjp5fdmM6K]{Pride in Arms}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AbjVJIBdNjbQbVnV]{Первісна егіда}

Ви отримуєте опір кислотній шкоді, холоду, електриці, вогню, життєвій і пустотній шкоді.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AbjVJIBdNjbQbVnV]{Primal Aegis}

You gain resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, vitality, and void damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.q8c0LINVNcJrdK91]{Рушійний стрибок}

Ви отримуєте Швидкість польоту, що дорівнює вашій Швидкості або 20 футам, залежно від того, що більше.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.q8c0LINVNcJrdK91]{Propulsive Leap}

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7G1gMSHyMdMGMsF9]{Protective Cycle}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.A9WrbBCCdYsmdKGv]{Protective Pose}

You gain resistance to either acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to half the origin's level.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.nn7DiYYWinsSYrZy]{Захисна маска духа}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до КЗ до початку наступного ходу заклинача.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.nn7DiYYWinsSYrZy]{Protective Spirit Mask}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of the caster's next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vD3l0Xn4hb7xnQic]{Proud Mentor}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uisI6b7Ua5zSHDwj]{Psi Strikes}

Your chosen attack deals an extra 1d6 force damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9oKtrUzXixj58hOg]{Психічний зв’язок}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до перевірок Обману, Дипломатії та Залякування, а також до перевірок Сприйняття для Відчуття мотивів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9oKtrUzXixj58hOg]{Psychic Rapport}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks, and to Perception checks to Sense Motive.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PpzH9tJULk5ksX9w]{Родовід: Психопомп}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до спаскидків Стійкості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PpzH9tJULk5ksX9w]{Bloodline: Psychopomp}

You gain a +2 status bonus to Fortitude saving throws.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.k42ntHdg70ZMEKrs]{Очищувальний бриз}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до спаскидків Стійкості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.k42ntHdg70ZMEKrs]{Purifying Breeze}

You gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saving throws.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BtZJJClWCpc31Ven]{Відтіснити мерців!}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до спаскидків проти ефектів, що походять від нежиті. Ви також отримуєте опір шкоді від Ударів істот-нежиті.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BtZJJClWCpc31Ven]{Push Back the Dead!}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects originating from undead. You also gain resistance to damage from Strikes made by undead creatures.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GxkTe4VM7u26uZGI]{Pushing Wind}

You gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to land Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MrTULCUsE9naPxXg]{Race the Skies}

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2XmdYW8OsAvjGDG3]{Сяйні контури}.

Ви випромінюєте яскраве світло в радіусі 20 футів (і тьмяне світло ще на 20 футів).
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2XmdYW8OsAvjGDG3]{Radiant Circuitry}.

You emit bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

name.original: Effect: Rage Temporary Hit Points Immunity

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}

You can't gain temporary Hit Points from using the Rage action.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Лють}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють вашому рівню плюс модифікатор Статури.

Ваші рукопашні Удари завдають додаткової шкоди. Ця додаткова шкода зменшується вдвічі, якщо ваша зброя або беззбройна атака має трейт швидкої.

Коли ви припиняєте Лють, то втрачаєте всі тимчасові ОЗ, що залишилися від Люті, і протягом 1 хвилини не можете знову отримати тимчасові ОЗ від використання дії Лють.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier.

You deal additional damage on melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.

When you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and can't gain temporary Hit Points from using the Rage action again for 1 minute.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BuVIM4cV7qhVZ2WF]{Raise Menhir}

Choose arcane, divine, or occult; all creatures within 15 feet of the monument gain a +2 status bonus to their saving throws against effects with that trait.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.koER7gKf6CnW5O0s]{Raise Symbol}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws until the start of your next turn. While it's raised, if you roll a success at a saving throw against a vitality or void effect, you get a critical success instead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IBEbFlMmDbGsrN4G]{Raise the Walls}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC, Reflex saves, and any save against force, spirit, vitality, or void effect.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.df4cBV3qZn3qNUmP]{Rallying Charge (Marshal)}

You gain temporary hit points equal to the Charisma modifier of the creature that used Rallying Charge.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Zl6vDXJEM7Lbp8JQ]{Шалена форма}

Ви Змінюєте форму на форму живого льоду на 1 хвилину або доки не повернетеся назад. Ваша бойова форма Величезна й має такі показники:

  • КЗ = 18 + ваш рівень. Ігноруйте штраф перевірок і зменшення Швидкості від вашої броні.

  • 20 тимчасових ОЗ.

  • Сутінковий зір і неточний нюх на 30 футів.

  • Швидкість 30 футів, Швидкість польоту 40 футів, і вам не потрібно дихати

  • Рукопашна a щелепи, Шкода 2d8 колючої + 1d4 шкоди вогнем.

  • Ваші беззбройні атаки завдають додатково 1d4 шкоди вогнем, а ваші закляття вогню завдають одну додаткову кістку шкоди вогнем (того самого розміру, що й кістка шкоди закляття).

  • Ви можете накладати @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Запалювання} як вроджене закляття; час накладання скорочується з 2 дій до 1.

  • Кожна істота, яка торкається вас або завдає вам шкоди беззбройною атакою чи рукопашною зброєю без досяжності, отримує @Damage[3d6[fire]] шкоди.

  • Модифікатор Атлетики +20, якщо ваш власний модифікатор не вищий.

Кіцуне Крижаних Вітрів:

  • Рукопашна a щелепи, Шкода 2d8 колючої + 1d4 шкоди холодом.

  • Ваші беззбройні атаки завдають додатково 1d4 шкоди холодом, а ваші закляття холоду завдають одну додаткову кістку шкоди холодом (того самого розміру, що й кістка шкоди закляття).

  • Ви можете накладати @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gYjPm7YwGtEa1oxh]{Промінь морозу} як вроджене закляття; час накладання скорочується з 2 дій до 1.

  • Кожна істота, яка торкається вас або завдає вам шкоди беззбройною атакою чи рукопашною зброєю без досяжності, отримує @Damage[3d6[cold]] шкоди.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Zl6vDXJEM7Lbp8JQ]{Rampaging Form}

You Change Shape into a form of living ice for 1 minute or until you shift back. Your battle form is Huge and has the following statistics:

  • AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

  • 20 temporary Hit Points.

  • Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.

  • A Speed of 30, a Fly speed of 40, and you don't need to breathe

  • Melee a jaws, Damage 2d8 piercing + 1d4 fire damage.

  • Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 additional fire damage, and your fire spells deal one additional die of fire damage (of the same damage die the spell uses).

  • You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition} as an innate spell; the casting is reduced from 2 actions to 1.

  • Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage.

  • Athletics modifier of +20, unless your own modifier is higher.

Frozen Winds Kitsune:

  • Melee a jaws, Damage 2d8 piercing + 1d4 cold damage.

  • Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 additional cold damage, and your cold spells deal one additional die of cold damage (of the same damage die the spell uses).

  • You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gYjPm7YwGtEa1oxh]{Ray of Frost} as an innate spell; the casting is reduced from 2 actions to 1.

  • Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes @Damage[3d6[cold]] damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Crd3qMecF9FYHjuH]{Розпізнати умовні слова}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до перевірок Дипломатії та Обману.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Crd3qMecF9FYHjuH]{Read Shibboleths}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Diplomacy and Deception checks.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5Cm2TYHzoO2DbQNM]{Посвята реаніматора}

На час дії виклику нежиті ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до кидків атаки, КЗ, спаскидків і перевірок навичок.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5Cm2TYHzoO2DbQNM]{Reanimator Dedication}

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, AC, saving throws, and skill checks for the duration of summon undead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mNiJvsbyxdLBnTRs]{Rebirth in Living Stone}

You gain temporary Hit Points. You're immune to critical hits and precision damage. Your earth Elemental Blasts deal an additional 1d10 damage of their normal type.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lH3mlvs1rCyXw6iY]{Пригадування під тиском}

Піднесення бойового духу надає вам статусний бонус +1 до спаскидків до кінця бойової сутички або статусний бонус +2, якщо витягнута карта належала до масті Книг.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lH3mlvs1rCyXw6iY]{Recall Under Pressure}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws for the remainder of the combat encounter as your morale soars or a +2 status bonus if the card you drew was from the suit of Books.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fqw1ELaqavuKLHIj]{Безрозсудна відвага}

Якщо ви отримуєте невдачу або критичну невдачу в спаскидку проти шкідливого ефекту, натомість отримуєте успіх.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fqw1ELaqavuKLHIj]{Reckless Abandon}

If you roll a failure or critical failure on a saving throw against a harmful effect, you get a success instead.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dHUoQVzDa9Cf4QCG]{Рефлекторний щит}

Ви додаєте обставинний бонус свого щита до спаскидків Рефлексу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dHUoQVzDa9Cf4QCG]{Reflexive Shield}

You gain your shield's cricumstance bonus to Reflex saves.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.DhdLzrcMvB93Rjmt]{Regalia}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against fear. If the origin has Regalia as an adept implement, this status bonus applies to mental effects, and you gain a status bonus to damage rolls.

If the origin has Regalia as a paragon implement, you aren't off-guard from being flanked unless the origin is flanked, and the status penalty you take from being clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, or stupefied is reduced by 1, unless the origin is affected by the same condition.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.l1I6bmdm31MPwmWU]{Regional Specialty}

You gain an item bonus against certain saves depending on the chosen element.

  • Wood Against disease and poison effects.
  • Fire Against being doomed or frightened.
  • Earth Against being enfeebled.
  • Metal Against being stupefied.
  • Water Against deafened or drained.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xZrTjUub7V09sXZF]{Rejuvenating Touch}

You gain 10 temporary Hit Points immediately and at the start of your turns.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Gw8tjM91F6i3fOnR]{Relinquish Control}

You gain a +4 status bonus on saves against spells and effects that give you the controlled condition or attempt to influence your actions.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on all Recall Knowledge checks made using Lore skills granted by your attuned apparitions.

The creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their AC that lasts until they can take 10 minutes to repair their armor. The creature can also Interact to adjust their armor, which removes this penalty for 1 minute.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3hhCDWPm021hvicR]{Відновлена міць}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють половині вашого рівня плюс модифікатор Статури. Якщо цього ходу ви виконали дію з трейтом атаки, кількість тимчасових ОЗ збільшується до вашого рівня плюс модифікатор Статури.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3hhCDWPm021hvicR]{Renewed Vigor}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level plus your Constitution modifier. If you made an attack action this turn, increase the number of temporary Hit Points to your level plus your Constitution modifier.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.frRJAuuAgDg3RFii]{Renewing Cycle}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZGT7NLpcvREkJsMd]{Модуль ремонту}

Ви отримуєте швидке зцілення, що дорівнює половині вашого рівня.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZGT7NLpcvREkJsMd]{Repair Module}

You gain fast healing equal to half your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SN3sVsU7rD2eBfkf]{Repel Ambient Magic}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the next magical attack, cantrip, or spell that targets you. This bonus increases to +2 at 12th level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aMef2VM4mSxl0pmy]{Replenishment of War}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, or equal to your level if the Strike was a critical hit.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tCuMXQ0yMrCNwzqW]{Resilient Touch}

You gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dTO1ShJovbzrKUY4]{Відлуння хоробрості}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +1 до спаскидків і тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють половині вашого рівня. Якщо ви отримали критичний успіх проти ефекту страху, ці переваги подвоюються.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dTO1ShJovbzrKUY4]{Resounding Bravery}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saves and a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. These benefits are doubled if you critically succeed against a fear effect.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mB7ENhF10qoOwQyG]{Resounding Cascade}

You emanate a 5-foot aura. If you're not the origin, you deal extra damage with your melee Strikes of the same damage type as the origin's Arcane Cascade damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lhSqWHXK1JShUabF]{Resounding Finale}

You gain sonic resistance against the triggering damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xUlRLkWnfZ7reej6]{Restorative Strike}

Cast a 1-action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell to heal yourself, expending the spell normally. It loses the manipulate trait when cast this way. Then make a melee Strike. If you make this Strike with your deity's favored weapon, you gain a +1 status bonus to the attack roll.

If the Strike hits, you can target a second willing creature to heal the same amount from the spell. This creature can be outside of the spell's range, provided it's adjacent to the enemy you hit.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dr6h8WRW6xnLRfxr]{Resurrectionist}

You gain fast healing 5.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.83zzG4XBiL5I3NZv]{Revitalizing Finisher}

You gain temporary Hit Points.
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Kz4E8heU12IGcYoi]{Righteous Resistance}

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fOwArAHixZsrpUMM]{Rise Up!}

You gain a fly Speed equal to their Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.F6TIEmYYJGmVhMXl]{Roaring Heart}

You gain temporary Hit Points.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZELjVKOohGw3ECwB]{Rod of Rule}

You take –2 circumstance penalty to saves against any of the origin's curriculum or sin spells.

name.original: Effect: Roll the Bones of Fate (Good)

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7Q7HWETkvOM9pYwV]{Roll the Bones of Fate}

You can roll twice on your next attack roll or skill check, taking the higher result.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.22P7IFyhrF7Fbw8B]{Root Magic}

You gain a circumstance bonus to a saving throw against a spell or haunt.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.LlV0KHIebzdczgyD]{Rose Warden Dedication}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC and saving throws against being confused, controlled, grabbed, immobilized, or restrained by a figure of authority

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.JvsjDU6mKKLl0NK4]{Runelord Researcher}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against the chosen effect.

  • Envy any effect that has the incapacitation trait (against foes who are higher level than you, the status bonus increases to +2)
  • Gluttony death effects and void
  • Greed polymorph and effects that can cause the following conditions: enfeebled, clumsy, or petrified
  • Lust emotion
  • Pride illusion
  • Sloth effects that cause paralysis, slow, stun, or that grant penalties to your Speed
  • Wrath effects that cause acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage (choose one)

Granted by Ruthless Orator

You take a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and spell attack rolls against the origin.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7HZaOlJ43QxkDrmO]{Ruthless Orator}

Any hostile creatures within 20 feet take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and spell attack rolls that target you.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tBg3FZST3nX5TfLf]{Захистити душу}

Ви отримуєте статусний бонус +2 до спаскидків проти ефектів смерті, одержимості та ефектів, які намагаються змінити або викрасти вашу душу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tBg3FZST3nX5TfLf]{Safeguard Soul}

You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against death effects, possession effects, and effects that attempt to manipulate or steal your soul.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xtXWw3cUnVB25XSV]{Sanctify Armament}

The weapon gains the origin's holy or unholy trait. It also deals an additional 2d6 spirit damage to creatures of the opposed trait.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ZI7TLmmUu7fYLrP0]{Sanguine Revitalization}

You take a circumstance penalty to your Fortitude save.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.csoGdGuWasEw3boD]{Астрологія Саок}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус або штраф до перевірок навичок.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.csoGdGuWasEw3boD]{Saoc Astrology}

You gain a circumstance bonus or penalty to skill checks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aFoVHsuInMOkTZoQ]{Incredible Scout}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Tpcq3Lk7qEOZ3LDP]{Попередження розвідника}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до кидка ініціативи (+2, якщо також отримуєте перевагу від @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Розвідки}).
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Tpcq3Lk7qEOZ3LDP]{Scout's Warning}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll (+2 if you also benefit from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}).

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CAHJGt535l3Ai4cR]{Sea Glass Guardians}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dWGa6cFSVrASTEfd]{Насіннєва коробочка}

Ви отримуєте обставинний штраф –10 футів до Швидкості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dWGa6cFSVrASTEfd]{Seedpod}

You take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.enQieRrITuEQZxx2]{Selfish Shield}

You gain resistance against the triggering damage equal to 2 + half your level, regardless of damage type.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3XFKXB3ffeIkrQYe]{Sense Iniquity}

you gain a +2 status bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} you, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to locate a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} creature or to see through a creature's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} attempt, you gain a +2 status bonus to the Perception check.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.uoQOm41BVdSo6pAS]{Bloodline: Shadow}

You gain a +1 status bonus to Stealth or a -1 status penalty to Perception.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ktgzHtKoeUZ5H8KA]{Shadow Sheath}

You load a weapon into the sheath.

Immanence Your Strikes with the weapon deal 2 additional spirit damage per weapon damage die, which increases to 3 per die if the target is off-guard.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NjPZbQjJJIygS1ru]{Тіньовий зір}

Ви отримуєте Покращений темнозір.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NjPZbQjJJIygS1ru]{Shadow Sight}

You gain Greater Darkvision.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1JnERVwnPtX620f2]{Animal Companion (Ranger)} with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AwxJcaIrutqMcUC8]{Masterful Companion}

Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against the marked creature is –2 (–1 with an agile attack) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –4 (–2 with an agile attack) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of –10.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1JnERVwnPtX620f2]{Animal Companion (Ranger)}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Aqhsx5duEpBgaPB0]{Shared Prey}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EHorYedQ8r05qAtk]{Triple Threat}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oHra9QanDFpAZ4hh]{Warden's Boon}

Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against the marked creature is –3 (–2 with an agile attack) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –6 (–4 with an agile attack) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of –10.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1JnERVwnPtX620f2]{Animal Companion (Ranger)} with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AwxJcaIrutqMcUC8]{Masterful Companion}

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks, Intimidation checks, Stealth checks, and any checks to Recall Knowledge about the marked creature, and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the marked creature's attacks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1JnERVwnPtX620f2]{Animal Companion (Ranger)}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Aqhsx5duEpBgaPB0]{Shared Prey}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EHorYedQ8r05qAtk]{Triple Threat}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oHra9QanDFpAZ4hh]{Warden's Boon}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks, Intimidation checks, Stealth checks, and any checks to Recall Knowledge about the marked creature, and a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the marked creature's attacks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1JnERVwnPtX620f2]{Animal Companion (Ranger)} with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AwxJcaIrutqMcUC8]{Masterful Companion}

The first time you hit the marked creature in a round, you deal 2d8 additional precision damage. At 19th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 precision damage.

The second time in a round you hit the marked creature, you also deal 1d8 precision damage. At 19th level this extra damage increases to 2d8 precision damage, and your third hit in a round against the marked creature deals 1d8 precision damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1JnERVwnPtX620f2]{Animal Companion (Ranger)}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Aqhsx5duEpBgaPB0]{Shared Prey}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EHorYedQ8r05qAtk]{Triple Threat}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oHra9QanDFpAZ4hh]{Warden's Boon}

The first time you hit the marked creature in a round, you deal 1d8 additional precision damage. At 11th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8 precision damage, and at 19th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 precision damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1JnERVwnPtX620f2]{Animal Companion (Ranger)}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Aqhsx5duEpBgaPB0]{Shared Prey}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EHorYedQ8r05qAtk]{Triple Threat}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oHra9QanDFpAZ4hh]{Warden's Boon}

You gain a +1 status bonus to your spell attack rolls against the marked creature, and they take a –1 status penalty to their saving throws against divine spells you cast.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vayNZR1bTzU1oUa3]{Поділитися люттю}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють вашому рівню плюс модифікатор Статури. Доки ви в Люті, ваші рукопашні Удари завдають 2 додаткової шкоди. Ця додаткова шкода зменшується вдвічі, якщо ваша зброя або беззбройна атака має трейт швидкої.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vayNZR1bTzU1oUa3]{Share Rage}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. While you are raging, you deal 2 additional damage on melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wIJC00ODLq9WYc1m]{Спільне уникнення}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до спаскидків проти небезпеки.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wIJC00ODLq9WYc1m]{Shared Avoidance}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against the hazard.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ybrx1nsg5J0L8d3j]{Спільна ясність}

Ви можете перекинути невдалий спаскидок проти ментального ефекту з обставинним бонусом +2.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ybrx1nsg5J0L8d3j]{Shared Clarity}

You can reroll the failed saving throw against the mental effect with a +2 circumstance bonus.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vFa9crHKkNkPUjFl]{Shared Sight}

You gain spiritsense.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QOnyOjncnw4tkTQp]{Shattershields}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t3IzY8uSyFj3aGmh]{Відкинути хвіст}

Ви отримуєте обставинний штраф –2 до перевірок Рівноваги.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t3IzY8uSyFj3aGmh]{Shed Tail}

You take a -2 circumstance penalty on checks to Balance.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HP1DKj4FLwtStzYq]{Sheltering Pulse}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

Granted by Sheltering Wing

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells. If you have Dragon's Flight, this bonus increases to +2.

description.translate: Твердість вашого оснащеного щита збільшується на 2.
description.original: The hardness of your equipped shield increases by 2.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wzJnJI6d2PaoTZIZ]{Shield from Arrows}

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.w3qyriA1YnzXaas3]{Shield of Faith}

You gain a +1 status bonus to your AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Swy3rjQsdO0wu2kU]{Paragon Benefit (Shield)}

You gain the origin's shield circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VYwWqm5LZOU7irhY]{Shield the Faithful}

You gain a +1 item bonus to AC and resistance to spirit damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3SiZ4hrNi8aWjP8J]{Shield Your Eyes}

If you critically succeed against the origin's DC with a light or visual trait, it's a success instead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xhqteilfGucKMGkU]{Shielded Recovery}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yOk8s1pftOe5I9Sg]{Shielding Wave}

You gain resistance to acid or fire damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iAziUKdxgy4k4ypY]{Shining Arms}

When a creature wielding the weapon critically hits a foe, you can Dismiss the spell as a reaction, causing the foe to be dazzled for 1 round

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tKC06HYkt1XaWk78]{Shining Glory}

You gain a +3 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks, and the status bonus you receive to saving throws against fear increases to +3.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DMjfZvWD20SGuIO4]{Show-Off}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level (double your level on a critical success).

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yiZwGVErxzWCJOlW]{Signature Weapon}

You gain access to its critical specialization effect of the selected weapon.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bI0PWJ4c3AOcFDWN]{Silk Bracelet}

You gain a -10 foot status penalty to all your Speeds for 1 round.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XdicxD5jMJ8JSVqk]{Siphon Torment}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the origin's level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sFAqKrzqXQhtrfqN]{Sixth Pillar Mastery}

You have a -1 status penalty to saves against spells from the source, or you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with your unarmed Strikes.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.b7yAKSmZ7famsENr]{Size Up}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when you Sense the Motive of your focus and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC should your focus attempt to Lie or Feint against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks against your focus

description.translate:
Надається Карою добра.

До початку вашого наступного ходу ваші Удари по цьому ворогу зброєю, у якій перебуває ваш союзник-клинок, завдають додатково 4 духовної шкоди, якщо ціль свята; ця шкода збільшується до 6, якщо ви маєте майстерне володіння цією зброєю.

Якщо обраний ворог атакує вас до початку вашого наступного ходу, тривалість подовжується до кінця наступного ходу цього ворога. Якщо ворог продовжує атакувати вас кожного ходу, тривалість продовжує подовжуватися.
description.original:
Granted by Smite Good.

Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes against that foe using the weapon your blade ally inhabits deal an extra 4 spirit damage if the target is holy, increasing to 6 if you have master proficiency with this weapon.

If the chosen enemy attacks you before the start of your next turn, the duration extends to the end of that enemy's next turn. If the enemy continues to attack you each turn, the duration continues to extend.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xgvKXeTxns0gIdAn]{Smite}.

Designate one enemy you can see. Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes against that enemy gain a +3 status bonus to damage, increasing to +4 if you have master proficiency with the weapon or unarmed attack you're using for the Strike. If you're holy or unholy and the target has the opposite trait, the bonus is +4 (or +6 if you're a master).

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zbnL5OP4zVaNFcq8]{Snap Out of It! (Marshal)}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Will save.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6PP57Aa5HmSr0qIZ]{Посвята снайперського дуету}.

Щоразу, коли ви або ваш коригувальник успішно виконуєте Удар по цілі, інший учасник дуету отримує обставинний бонус +1 за кожну кістку шкоди зброї до кидка шкоди свого наступного Удару по цій цілі до кінця свого наступного ходу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6PP57Aa5HmSr0qIZ]{Sniping Duo Dedication}.

Whenever you or your spotter successfully Strikes a target, the other member of your duo gains a +1 circumstance bonus per weapon damage die on the damage roll of their next Strike made against that target before the end of their next turn.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Tl8yckXeTCHnwrlM]{Стрімкий політ}

Для цього переміщення ви отримуєте Швидкість польоту 20 футів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Tl8yckXeTCHnwrlM]{Soaring Flight}

You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BAsKBwlbJAQ6sLhN]{Soothing Vials}

The creature gains a +1 item bonus to the new Will saving throw.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.moJh856BHCXtPCJm]{Soul Oubliette}

You gain fast healing 15.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.drcZf55HVsTnnTcF]{Soul Vessel Mount}

You gain a +20-foot status bonus to your Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B8MKXr7mMzOHhTQH]{Soul Well}

Your spectral dagger deals one additional weapon die of damage until the end of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B8MKXr7mMzOHhTQH]{Soul Well}

Living creatures in the aura die from the dying condition at dying 5 rather than dying 4.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BL2nLeClO30QoQGs]{Spark Fist}

Your fist loses the nonlethal trait and deals additional fire damage on a successful Strike.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X9AkydrMdFwg7qIn]{Spell Parry}

You raise your guard, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3CPKbiweBRzXAJA9]{Spell Protection Array}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9p28s0zg4Vv4r5i2]{Spike Skin}

You gain resistance to all physical damage, except adamantine.

description.translate: Ви отримуєте бонус до статусу +1 для кидків атаки та захисних кидків проти лиходія до початку вашого наступного ходу.
description.original: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws against the marked villain.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ef57tIj30IaPnSgC]{Присяга спіралі}

Ваші Удари та закляття завдають додаткової шкоди нежиті, істотам, які містять ув’язнену душу, або істотам, що, як ви бачили, створювали чи контролювали нежить. Ви отримуєте статусний бонус до шкоди Ударами проти цих істот, що дорівнює кількості кісток шкоди зброї. Закляття, які ви накладаєте з комірок заклять, отримують статусний бонус до шкоди проти цих істот, що дорівнює рангу закляття; цей бонус застосовується лише до заклять, які завдають шкоди й не мають тривалості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ef57tIj30IaPnSgC]{Spiral Sworn}

Your Strikes and spells deal additional damage against undead, creatures in possession of an imprisoned soul, or creatures you have witnessed create or command undead. You gain a status bonus to damage with your Strikes against these creatures equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Spells you cast from spell slots gain a status bonus to damage against these creatures equal to the rank of the spell; this bonus applies only to spells that deal damage and don't have a duration.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WKRSBu7H9miAwUaR]{Spirit Guide Form}

You fuse with your spirit guide, becoming a hybrid being with enhanced physical and spiritual power. This effect lasts 1 minute; you can end it early as a free action. During this time, you can't use any other actions granted by this archetype. You gain the following statistics and abilities, regardless of your type of spirit guide.

  • You become incorporeal.
  • You gain resistance 10 to all damage (except force, ghost touch, or spirit; double resistance vs. non-magical).
  • Darkvision.

  • An unarmed melee attack of the same type as your spirit guide (either claws or jaws), which is the only attack you can Strike with. You're trained with this attack. Your attack modifier is +29 or your normal unarmed attack modifier, whichever is higher. You use the listed statistics for the unarmed attack type:

    • Claws (agile, backstabber, finesse) 1, Damage 3d6+5 slashing plus 1d6 force;
    • Jaws (forceful) 1, Damage 3d10+5 piercing plus 1d6 force.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hjApw8AvYVuqQk2W]{Spirits' Interference} via Ephemeral Effect.

You must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or your attack against the origin misses with no effect.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SPtzUNatWJvTK61y]{Spirit's Mercy}

You gain resistance to vitality and void damage (or resistance to all damage if caused by a haunt or incorporeal undead) against the triggering effect. If you expend a spirit wisp, the resistance is equal to twice your level. If you expend a spirit remnant, the resistance is equal to three times the level of the incorporeal undead or haunt from which you gained the remnant.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fngPLUD4Sltho2kn]{Staggering Fire}

You take a –5-foot circumstance penalty to your Speed, or a –10-foot circumstance penalty on a critical hit.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jK0hjx4qsRyKnpBd]{Зоряна броня}

Ви отримуєте опір 7 колючій, дроблячій і рубаючій шкоді. Ви також випромінюєте яскраве світло на 20 футів (і тьмяне світло ще на 20 футів).

Коли ви досягаєте 17-го рівня, опір збільшується до 10.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jK0hjx4qsRyKnpBd]{Starlight Armor}

You gain resistance 7 to piercing, bludgeoning, and slashing damage. You also shed bright light for 20 feet (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

When you reach 17th level, the resistance increases to 10.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M4ALaFXoQDJGxSsI]{Starlit Transformation}

Your weapon gains a +1 status bonus to damage rolls. You can fling bolts of starlight from your weapon with a Strike action, using your melee attack modifier with the weapon. These bolts deal 1d4 force damage and have the arcane and force traits.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2tF5kSGaSEmhQg1i]{Starstone Aspirant Dedication}

You can choose a skill you're untrained in. You can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained in that skill, and you gain a circumstance bonus to checks with that skill.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Kb28vpCQNvA6wS1O]{Steal Death}

You gain fast healing as long as you and your apocalypse mount are within 10 feet of each other. If you use Steal Death again, your fast healing increases by 1.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4Y7wKFogGB0LZ5ZA]{Steel Yourself!}

You gain temporary Hit Points and a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xgg9eNF6MsJPMjyH]{Stone Body}

You gain resistance 10 to all damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CSa7v4MtbiA3FI0c]{Stoney Deflection}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and to any defenses against being Shoved or Tripped

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tQvWDkatsuYsNkds]{Storied Companion}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice the origin's level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.u8YnTCS2EGoJl90W]{Strain Mind}

You lose Hit Points equal to four times the spell rank of the amped psi cantrip.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.huDGjojm3hnuA1E8]{Перенапружений метаболізм}

Легка віддача Ви стаєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Ослабленими 1} та @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Незграбними 1}, доки не з’їсте шматок їжі (зазвичай для цього потрібні 2 дії Взаємодії: одна, щоб дістати їжу, та інша, щоб її з’їсти).

Помірна віддача Ви Ослаблені 1, Незграбні 1 та @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Втомлені}, доки не з’їсте повноцінну страву, що потребує щонайменше 10 хвилин.

Сильна віддача Через сильну нудоту ви отримуєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Нудоту 2}, а також залишаєтеся Ослабленими 1 і Незграбними 1, доки не з’їсте повноцінну страву (для чого ви спершу маєте позбутися Нудоти). Ви залишаєтеся Втомленими, доки не відпочинете повну ніч.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.huDGjojm3hnuA1E8]{Strained Metabolism}

Mild Backlash You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until you take a bite of food (which usually requires 2 Interact actions: one to retrieve the food and another to consume it).

Moderate Backlash You are enfeebled 1, clumsy 1, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until you can eat a full meal, which requires at least 10 minutes.

Severe Backlash You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} as nausea wracks you, and you are also enfeebled 1 and clumsy 1 until you can eat a full meal (which requires you to no longer be sickened). You are fatigued until you can get a full night's rest.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lMA3F9SGzGV79P5C]{Strangle}

You must succeed at a DC 10 flat check or lose any action that requires speech. For an action requiring speech that is also a manipulate action, like Casting a Spell with the concentrate and manipulate trait, you just roll a single DC 10 flat check, rather than an additional DC 5 flat check for being grabbed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fJwsZM6WXwP8EStV]{Strategist Stance}

Your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to Reflex saving throws

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TGlb3gmSKkJBZt5q]{Разюча відплата}

Ваш обставинний бонус до шкоди зброєю та беззбройними атаками проти істот із родини алґоллту й тих, хто їм служить, збільшується до +4
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TGlb3gmSKkJBZt5q]{Striking Retribution}

Your circumstance bonus to damage with weapons and unarmed attacks against creatures from the alghollthu family and those that serve alghollthus increases to +4

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.S2YTLXTvqaXhThG6]{Stymie the Gods}

You gain a status bonus to AC and to saving throws against divine spells, as well as the spells, Strikes, and abilities of extraplanar creatures.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ACVze8hUm9L5Slrg]{Such a Disgrace!}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to reroll a Will saving throw.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qV6EuOI3UJYIL6xa]{Об’єднаний накладний паноптикон}

Ви отримуєте темнозір і сутінковий зір, а також статусний бонус +1 до візуальних перевірок Сприйняття.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qV6EuOI3UJYIL6xa]{Consolidated Overlay Panopticon}

You gain darkvision and low-light vision, and you gain a +1 status bonus to visual Perception checks.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zzjfENthtRBAjqjQ]{Surgical Shock}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the next attack action you attempt against the target.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.NdMSHDtV9G7MbdP2]{Survive the Wilds}

You and all allies in a 15-foot emanation gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against effects with the trait the pelt is attuned to.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.nplVDMxYDqdMC32k]{Swift Support}

You gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmFv3ClkAVRowHLI]{Tengu Weapon Familiarity}

During your daily preparations, you can practice with a weapon from the sword group that's in your possession. You gain familiarity with that weapon as well. This lasts until you practice with a different sword in the same way.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VOgAiCqC5kpIpLaf]{Sympathetic Strike}

You take –1 circumstance penalty to your saves against the origin's hexes, or a –2 penalty if the triggering Strike was a critical hit.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Xdmz09kzLjIxWz9C]{Tactical Debilitations}

The target can't flank or contribute to allies' flanking.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ev8OHpBO3xq3Zt08]{Хвостовий токсин}

Ви наносите отруту зі свого хвоста на колючу або рубаючу зброю. Якщо ваш наступний Удар цією зброєю до кінця наступного ходу влучає та завдає шкоди, ви завдаєте цілі тривалої шкоди отрутою, що дорівнює вашому рівню.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ev8OHpBO3xq3Zt08]{Tail Toxin}

You apply your tail's venom to a piercing or slashing weapon. If your next Strike with that weapon before the end of your next turn hits and deals damage, you deal persistent poison damage equal to your level to the target.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jsEBrm8SPcsokJLw]{Tap the Past}

You roll a second time and use the higher result. If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. If you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DLkMoVb8qb4qxnx3]{Targeting Finisher}

You gain an effect based on the selected body part.

  • Arm (or another limb used for attacks, such as a tentacle) You are enfeebled 1.
  • Head You are stupefied 1.
  • Legs You take a –5-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DLkMoVb8qb4qxnx3]{Targeting Finisher}

You gain an effect based on the selected body part.

  • Arm (or another limb used for attacks, such as a tentacle) You are enfeebled 2.
  • Head You are stupefied 2.
  • Legs You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.drAXPlcNyrIdPm1L]{Targeting Strike}

Your attack against the marked target deals an amount of additional precision damage equal to the origin's Intelligence modifier.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt}

You take a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and DCs that don't target the origin. If you take a hostile action that doesn't target the origin, you also become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.E8SDesgMD6Zbye2j]{Geomancer Dedication}

You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.E8SDesgMD6Zbye2j]{Geomancer Dedication}

You take a –5-foot status penalty to your Speeds (–10-foot on a critical failure).

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ogso0WqodeFG27L1]{Speak for the Gravelands}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against spells and abilities of haunts and undead creatures.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.E8SDesgMD6Zbye2j]{Geomancer Dedication}

You gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to the spell's rank.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.E8SDesgMD6Zbye2j]{Geomancer Dedication}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.E8SDesgMD6Zbye2j]{Geomancer Dedication}

You gain darkvision as well as imprecise tremorsense out to 15 feet.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TNRB8IY6Wtk9BoMp]{Terrain Shield}

You gain resistance to physical damage equal to double your level against the triggering Strike.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Egx5NWOVhoaij7a3]{Terrifying Mien}

You gain resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage against Strikes made by creatures with the frightened condition. This resistance is equal to four times the value of that creature's frightened condition.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Czcdh3pPzQ7y1cV7]{The Bigger They Are}

You gain a circumstance bonus to your check to Reposition, Shove, or Trip.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.azF1RvMTwCPaJr1F]{The Bigger They Are}

You gain weakness to the origin's precision damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.GF9uIGA947DiC2dR]{The Proud}

You take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks against creatures other than the exemplar, and a +1 status bonus to these rolls when targeting the exemplar.

name.original: Effect: The Truth As I See It

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KobkrExhlNeFaNR5]{The Truth As I See It}

When using Deception to Lie, you can roll twice and take the better result.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XJCsa3UbQtsKcqve]{Thermal Nimbus}

You gain cold or fire resistance.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pqVG9mRKcXg5Rsjc]{Thoughtform Summoning}

You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level and weakness 5 to force and mental damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bPPcPUZMlJ7m5lYq]{Припливний щит}

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +4 до КЗ.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bPPcPUZMlJ7m5lYq]{Tidal Shield}

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Wo0HNBh6CCgPN3Co]{Погін орача}

Учасники вашого загону отримують обставинний бонус +5 футів до Швидкості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Wo0HNBh6CCgPN3Co]{Tiller's Drive}

Members of your crop receive a +5-foot circumstance bonus to Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1fH3M3XaUWWOJZFM]{To War!}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the origin's level and a +2 status bonus to damage against any foe damaged by the origin's apocalypse mount.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.MyN1cQgE0HsLF20e]{Tome}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against the marked creature. If you have the tome's paragon benefit, this bonus applies to all attack rolls.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RHEdvEFz3QKiRKlr]{Повалити велетнів}

Коли союзник у вашому полі спостереження невдало намагається @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Роззброїти}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Штовхнути} або @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Повалити} ворога у вашому полі спостереження, ви координуєте зусилля та надаєте обставинний бонус +2 до наступної перевірки Атлетики іншого союзника, який до наступного ходу цілі намагатиметься виконати ту саму дію проти тієї самої цілі.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RHEdvEFz3QKiRKlr]{Topple Giants}

When an ally within your overwatch field attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an opponent within your overwatch field and fails, you coordinate efforts to provide a +2 circumstance bonus to the next Athletics check rolled by a different ally to attempt the same action on the same target before that target's next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RNBr91uB7lX9DldN]{Tough Cookie}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your maximum Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t3Eky3ijnAJTiCV5]{Towering Presence}

You increase your size your size to Large. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny), and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.PpJURSJFEHzhutdp]{Trailblazing Stride}

You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KANcYBVhzcpSat9s]{Trance of Celerity}

If you are cursebound 2 at any point, the bonus increases to a +10-foot status bonus. If you are cursebound 3, this bonus increases to +15-foot status bonus instead. Finally, if you are cursebound 4 at any point during this duration, this bonus increases to a +20-foot status bonus.

description.translate: Надається, коли хтось використовує на вас @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Лікувати рани}, роблячи вас тимчасово імунними до Лікування ран на вказану тривалість.
description.original: Granted when someone uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on you, rendering you temporarily immune to Treat Wounds for the duration.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0HgfWQMIo2UEAlAm]{Tributary Circulation}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves and saves against poison.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4mDk8SQyx9dRxy9y]{Tripartite Omen}

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5g0gCXJnUVipYtW0]{Turn Aside Ambient Magic}

Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. You gain resistance against the chosen damage type equal to half your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3aG0gkHulBIHqqGE]{Turn Back the Clock}

You reroll the triggering check with a +1 circumstance bonus.

description.translate:
Надається @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Подвійним парируванням}, якщо хоча б одна зброя має трейт парирування.

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +2 до КЗ до початку свого наступного ходу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry} if either weapon has the parry trait.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

description.translate:
Надається @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Подвійним парируванням}, якщо жодна зброя не має трейту парирування.

Ви отримуєте обставинний бонус +1 до КЗ до початку свого наступного ходу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry} if neither weapon has the parry trait.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cwBsPU24715fUCub]{Ultimatum of Liberation}

You gain a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws against effects produced by the oppressing creature and their allies, which increases to +3 if they are within 30 feet of the origin.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bNUNyR3FDkgEb0gJ]{Unbreaking Castle}

You gain a circumstance bonus to AC.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9Ht1eyBHsB1swpeE]{Uncanny Bombs}

You reduce any circumstance bonus to the target's AC from cover by 1.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.7WBZ2kkhZ7JorWu2]{Bloodline: Undead}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank for 1 round.

description.translate: Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xSYkYRKlSyLzPrH1]{Невмируща переконаність}
description.original: Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xSYkYRKlSyLzPrH1]{Undying Conviction}

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xSYkYRKlSyLzPrH1]{Невмируща переконаність}

Істоти-нежить отримують статусний бонус +2 до спаскидків проти життєвої шкоди та до спаскидків Волі проти ефектів, які зробили б їх підконтрольними.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xSYkYRKlSyLzPrH1]{Undying Conviction}

Undead creatures gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws to resist vitality damage and to Will saving throws to resist effects that would make them controlled.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zZOycr00XDVTKuXa]{Undying Ferocity}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RR0p9E6GWt0CRA1q]{Unending Subsistence}

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saving throws.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZyQYP7i26DWhMNux]{Unfazed Assessment}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the target creature's attacks (or a +2 circumstance bonus for a critical success).

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7GeguyqyD1TjoC4r]{Вивільнити психіку}

Коли ви накладаєте закляття, що завдає шкоди, за допомогою свого психічного чаклування, ви отримуєте статусний бонус до його шкоди, що дорівнює подвоєному рангу закляття. Це застосовується лише до початкової шкоди, якої закляття завдає під час накладання, і кожна окрема істота отримує цю шкоду лише раз за закляття, навіть якщо закляття мало б завдати їй шкоди кілька разів.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7GeguyqyD1TjoC4r]{Unleash Psyche}

When you cast a damaging spell using your psychic spellcasting, you gain a status bonus to its damage equal to double the spell's rank. This applies only to the initial damage the spell deals when cast, and an individual creature takes this damage only once per spell, even if the spell would damage that creature multiple times.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fjB514XFJG4V3wMy]{Unleash Yaoguai Might}

When you Change Shape to enter your yaoguai form, you can spend an additional action to gain the effects of enlarge and an additional effect based on your heritage.

  • Animal Your hide thickens, granting a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.
  • Celestial You recover some of your celestial perfection, granting you and all allies within 15 feet a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.
  • Elements You're surrounded in wind and dust, granting concealment each round that you spend at least 1 action that has the move trait. You can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak, as normal for sources of obvious concealment.
  • Object Your skin transmutes partially into an inorganic substance, granting resistance 5 to your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.
  • Vegetation You trigger an accelerated growth, gaining fast healing 5.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.jIAgXe2FetAKBwt7]{Innovation} failing an Unstable check

The innovation malfunctions in a spectacular (though harmless) fashion, such as a belch of smoke or shower of sparks, and it becomes incapable of being used for further unstable actions.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1rbB6bYDqjR4gVTH]{Unsteadying Strike}

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your Fortitude DC to resist being Grappled, Repositioned, or Shoved and a –2 circumstance penalty to your Reflex DC to resist being Disarmed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KofrLYBif2QKyiqe]{Unwavering Resilience}

You gain a number of temporary Hit Point equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.F0JgJR2rXKOg9k1z]{Upstage}

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks until the end of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zV4vzcl7eoVewz5p]{Ursine Avenger Form}

You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and a claws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile trait.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EPqhCeCo1uOvJSTZ]{Vellumis Excision}

You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against curses, diseases, and poisons.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6m2oJVzwufgjJi9W]{Vengeful Remnant}

You gain resistance 10 to all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit, and vitality, doubled if the source of the damage is non-magical.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zt5CWn3UrPViwaB3]{Vicious Debilitations}

You gain weakness 5 to your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YeVDITJplindA27l]{Переможна міць}

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють модифікатору Статури, до кінця свого наступного ходу.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YeVDITJplindA27l]{Victorious Vigor}

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier until the end of your next turn.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.pHUi7KCh1DH5pxMe]{Victor's Wreath}

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4SKech3n0F38HrR5]{Vigorous Anthem}

You gain temporary HP equal to 3 + the source's Charisma modifier.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.QOOwC3S41CKGkxlN]{Vindicator}

You take a –1 status penalty to their saving throws against divine spells.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fns6SMiYrUeL6cnx]{Virulent Strike}

You take a –4 circumstance penalty to the save against a disease or poison.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2MHzEh1KUQEbhjUf]{Жвавий бравурний вчинок}.

Ви отримуєте тимчасові ОЗ, що дорівнюють вашому рівню плюс модифікатор Харизми.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2MHzEh1KUQEbhjUf]{Vivacious Bravado}.

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vKFg7HMNu4cCDD8b]{Volatile Grease}

The target gains weakness 2 to fire for 1 minute.

Heightened (+2) The weakness increases by 1.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vKFg7HMNu4cCDD8b]{Volatile Grease}

The target gains weakness 2 to fire until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+2) The weakness increases by 1.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.GpT5RXUwhINODqkJ]{(Affinity Ablaze) Arms of Balance: Walking the Cardinal Paths}

One of your weapons or your unarmed Strikes deal an additional 2d6 fire, cold, acid, or electricity damage. The Strikes gain the appropriate energy trait as well.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zZCyJhsaugHB6mZW]{Watch Your Back}

You can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} due to flanking.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zZCyJhsaugHB6mZW]{Watch Your Back}

The target gains a +2 status bonus to Perception checks against you, but it takes a –2 status penalty to Will saves against fear effects.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KKUDZUbX3nDdME4K]{Пильний погляд}

До початку свого наступного ходу ви отримуєте Всебічний зір. Він дає змогу бачити в усіх напрямках і не дозволяє взяти вас у фланг.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KKUDZUbX3nDdME4K]{Watchful Gaze}

You gain All-Around Vision until the start of your next turn. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Gvx8Mdg5mxUtTD5g]{Weapon Infusion}.

If your next action is an Elemental Blast, choose a weapon shape for it to take. You can choose to change the blast's damage type to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing-whichever suits the weapon shape-and you can choose other alterations depending on whether you make a melee or ranged blast.

  • Melee Add one of the following traits of your choice: agile, backswing, forceful, reach, sweep.
  • Ranged Choose one of three options: range increment 100 feet and the volley 30 feet trait, range increment 50 feet and the propulsive trait, or range increment 20 feet and the thrown trait.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SheifYobjKqyK3Fv]{Втручання}

Вашу зброю зіпсовано! Ви отримуєте обставинний штраф –2 до кидків атаки та шкоди цією зброєю. Ефект триває, доки ви не використаєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Взаємодію}, щоб усунути його.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SheifYobjKqyK3Fv]{Tamper}

Your weapon has been tampered with! You take a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls with that weapon. The effect lasts until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to remove it.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SheifYobjKqyK3Fv]{Втручання}

Вашу зброю зіпсовано! Ви отримуєте обставинний штраф –2 до кидків атаки та шкоди цією зброєю. Ефект завершується на початку наступного ходу винахідника або коли ви використаєте @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Взаємодію}, щоб усунути його.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.SheifYobjKqyK3Fv]{Tamper}

Your weapon has been tampered with! You take a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls with that weapon. The effect ends at the start of the inventor's next turn, or until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to remove it.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nYR1q5D1jLiJj4JM]{Weaponsight}

You can't be flanked.
The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.55WR55op9BIdgF1B]{Whispers of Weakness}

You target one creature. You gain a +2 status bonus to your next attack roll (or skill check made as part of an attack action) against that foe.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.pgqhlWAJ18FXaHeO]{Whose Cry is Thunder}

Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon while you're charged takes 1d6 electricity damage.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.U9mK9TXbGriGeMOW]{Wild Mimic Dedication}

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against the next attack or ability that the subject of your Recall Knowledge targets you with.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FUOUyhHufNH4ri7H]{Крила повітря}

Ви отримуєте Швидкість польоту, що дорівнює вашій наземній Швидкості.
description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FUOUyhHufNH4ri7H]{Wings of Air}

You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.N6U02s9qJKQIvmQd]{Wish for Luck}

Roll the attack roll, saving throw, or skill check twice and take the higher result.

description.translate: Надається, коли ви призначаєте когось своїм @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.52QyoGaysrfBOy5H]{Підопічним відьми}.
description.original: Granted when you designate someone as your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.52QyoGaysrfBOy5H]{Witch's Charge}.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hmpkzEQV6kTFxPan]{Wither Away}

You take the following penalties depending on the result

  • Arms You become enfeebled 1.
  • Head You become stupefied 1.
  • Legs You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.
  • Torso You gain weakness 10 to slashing damage.
You gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jynhIXH1zEavQA7v]{Worm Form}

You take on the form of a purple worm or transform into a humanoid-worm hybrid, retaining your own head but with a worm's body, transforming into a Huge battle form. You must have enough space to expand into or the ability is lost. While in this form, you gain the animal trait. You can Dismiss the form.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

  • AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 40 temporary Hit Points.
  • Darkvision.
  • One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +25, and you use the listed damage. Melee attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • Athletics modifier of +30, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of monster you choose:

  • Purple Worm Speed 40 feet, burrow 30 feet, swim 20 feet
    • Melee 1 jaws (deadly 2d10, reach 15 feet), Damage 3d10+15 piercing
    • Melee 1 stinger (agile, poison, reach 15 feet), Damage 2d12+15 piercing plus 2d6 persistent poison
    • Melee 1 body (reach 15 feet) Damage 1d10+13 bludgeoning
  • Hybrid Speed 40 feet
    • Melee 1 stinger (agile, poison, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d12+15 piercing plus 1d6 persistent poison
    • Melee 1 body (reach 10 feet), Damage 1d10+13 bludgeoning
    • Hybrid Caster You retain the ability to speak, and can cast spells as long as they don't have somatic or material components.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ykqZmY0CsaV1kyt4]{Wrathful Presence}

You gain a +3 status bonus to damage with your Strikes.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.dKTb959aCQIzSIXj]{Bloodline: Wyrmblessed}

Either you gain a +1 status bonus to Intimidation checks for 1 round, or a target takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves for 1 round.

name.original: Effect: You Can't Kill an Idea

description.original:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.R5oeNpNCOXU4OtIT]{You Can't Kill an Idea}

Your Aid circumstance bonus increases by 1.

description.translate:
Джерело ефекту: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.13bMIkqXpKt9pxAm]{Ти — ганьба!}

Ви перекидаєте тригерний спаскидок Волі з обставинним бонусом +1.
description.original:
